import { v4 as uuidv4 } from './uuid.js';
import { saveToStorage } from './storage.js';

function numero(value) {
  const n = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
}

export function createComprasService(data) {
  if (!Array.isArray(data.compras)) {
    data.compras = [];
  }

  function list() {
    return data.compras;
  }

  function getById(id) {
    return list().find(
      item => String(item.id) === String(id)
    ) || null;
  }

  function validar(payload = {}) {
    const erros = [];

    if (!payload.fornecedorId) {
      erros.push('Fornecedor Ã© obrigatÃ³rio');
    }

    if (!payload.data) {
      erros.push('Data Ã© obrigatÃ³ria');
    }

    if (
      !Array.isArray(payload.itens) ||
      payload.itens.length === 0
    ) {
      erros.push('Adicione pelo menos um item');
    }

    (payload.itens || []).forEach((item, index) => {
      if (!item.insumoId) {
        erros.push(`Item ${index + 1}: Insumo obrigatÃ³rio`);
      }

      if (!numero(item.quantidade) || numero(item.quantidade) <= 0) {
        erros.push(`Item ${index + 1}: Quantidade invÃ¡lida`);
      }

      const preco =
        item.precoUnitario !== undefined
          ? numero(item.precoUnitario)
          : numero(item.valorUnitario);

      if (preco < 0) {
        erros.push(`Item ${index + 1}: PreÃ§o invÃ¡lido`);
      }
    });

    return erros;
  }

  function recalcularItem(item = {}) {
    const quantidade = numero(item.quantidade);

    const precoUnitario =
      item.precoUnitario !== undefined
        ? numero(item.precoUnitario)
        : numero(item.valorUnitario);

    const descontoValor =
      Math.max(0, numero(item.descontoValor));

    const descontoUnitario =
      descontoValor > 0 && quantidade > 0
        ? descontoValor / quantidade
        : 0;

    const precoUnitarioLiquido =
      Math.round(
        (precoUnitario - descontoUnitario) * 1000000
      ) / 1000000;

    const subtotal =
      Math.round(
        quantidade * precoUnitarioLiquido * 100
      ) / 100;

    const mapped = {
      insumoId: item.insumoId || null,
      quantidade,
      precoUnitario,
      descontoValor,
      precoUnitarioLiquido,
      subtotal,

      // Compatibilidade temporÃ¡ria.
      valorUnitario: precoUnitario,
    };

    if (numero(item.precoEmbalagem) > 0) {
      mapped.precoEmbalagem = numero(item.precoEmbalagem);
    }

    if (numero(item.qtdEmbalagens) > 0) {
      mapped.qtdEmbalagens = numero(item.qtdEmbalagens);
    }

    return mapped;
  }

  function normalizeItems(items = []) {
    if (!Array.isArray(items)) return [];

    return items
      .map(recalcularItem)
      .filter(item =>
        item.insumoId &&
        item.quantidade > 0
      );
  }

  function calcularTotal(items = []) {
    return normalizeItems(items).reduce(
      (total, item) => total + numero(item.subtotal),
      0
    );
  }

  function calculateTotal(items = []) {
    return calcularTotal(items);
  }

  function create(payload = {}) {
    const itens = normalizeItems(payload.itens || []);

    const erros = validar({
      ...payload,
      itens,
    });

    if (erros.length) {
      return {
        sucesso: false,
        erros,
      };
    }

    const total = calcularTotal(itens);

    const compra = {
      id: payload.id || uuidv4(),
      fornecedorId: payload.fornecedorId,
      data: payload.data,
      itens,
      total,

      // Compatibilidade com Financeiro/modular anterior.
      valor: total,

      formaPagamento: payload.formaPagamento || '',
      observacoes: String(payload.observacoes || '').trim(),
      status: 'pendente',
      lancamentoFinanceiroId: null,
      recebimentoEstoqueId: null,
      criadoEm: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    data.compras.push(compra);
    persist();

    return {
      sucesso: true,
      compra,
    };
  }

  function update(id, payload = {}) {
    const index = list().findIndex(
      item => String(item.id) === String(id)
    );

    if (index === -1) {
      return {
        sucesso: false,
        erros: ['Compra nÃ£o encontrada'],
      };
    }

    const atual = data.compras[index];

    if (atual.status !== 'pendente') {
      return {
        sucesso: false,
        erros: ['Apenas compras pendentes podem ser editadas'],
      };
    }

    const itens = normalizeItems(payload.itens || []);

    const erros = validar({
      ...payload,
      itens,
    });

    if (erros.length) {
      return {
        sucesso: false,
        erros,
      };
    }

    const total = calcularTotal(itens);

    data.compras[index] = {
      ...atual,
      fornecedorId: payload.fornecedorId,
      data: payload.data,
      itens,
      total,
      valor: total,
      formaPagamento: payload.formaPagamento || '',
      observacoes: String(payload.observacoes || '').trim(),
      atualizadoEm: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    persist();

    return {
      sucesso: true,
      compra: data.compras[index],
    };
  }

  function remove(id) {
    const compra = getById(id);

    if (!compra) {
      return {
        sucesso: false,
        erro: 'Compra nÃ£o encontrada',
      };
    }

    if (compra.status !== 'pendente') {
      return {
        sucesso: false,
        erro: 'Apenas compras pendentes podem ser removidas',
      };
    }

    data.compras = list().filter(
      item => String(item.id) !== String(id)
    );

    persist();

    return { sucesso: true };
  }

  function receberCompra(compraId, estoqueService) {
    const compra = getById(compraId);

    if (!compra) {
      return {
        sucesso: false,
        erro: 'Compra nÃ£o encontrada',
      };
    }

    if (compra.status !== 'pendente') {
      return {
        sucesso: false,
        erro: 'Esta compra jÃ¡ foi processada',
      };
    }

    const executadas = [];

    for (const item of compra.itens) {
      const resultado =
        estoqueService.registrarEntrada({
          insumoId: item.insumoId,
          quantidade: item.quantidade,
          custoUnitario:
            item.precoUnitarioLiquido ??
            item.precoUnitario,
          origem: 'compra',
          referenciaId: compraId,
        });

      if (!resultado.ok) {
        estoqueService
          .removerEntradasDaCompra(compraId);

        return {
          sucesso: false,
          erro: `Erro no estoque: ${resultado.erro}`,
        };
      }

      executadas.push(resultado);
    }

    const index = list().findIndex(
      item => String(item.id) === String(compraId)
    );

    data.compras[index].status = 'recebida';
    data.compras[index].dataRecebimento =
      new Date().toISOString();

    // Compatibilidade temporÃ¡ria.
    data.compras[index].recebimentoEstoqueId = compraId;

    persist();

    return { sucesso: true };
  }

  function estornarRecebimento(compraId, estoqueService) {
    const compra = getById(compraId);

    if (!compra) {
      return {
        sucesso: false,
        erro: 'Compra nÃ£o encontrada',
      };
    }

    if (compra.status !== 'recebida') {
      return {
        sucesso: false,
        erro: 'Apenas compras recebidas podem ser estornadas',
      };
    }

    const resultado =
      estoqueService.removerEntradasDaCompra(compraId);

    if (!resultado.sucesso) {
      return resultado;
    }

    const index = list().findIndex(
      item => String(item.id) === String(compraId)
    );

    data.compras[index].status = 'pendente';
    data.compras[index].recebimentoEstoqueId = null;

    delete data.compras[index].dataRecebimento;

    persist();

    return { sucesso: true };
  }

  function vincularLancamentoFinanceiro(compraId, lancamentoId) {
    const compra = getById(compraId);

    if (!compra) {
      return {
        sucesso: false,
        erro: 'Compra nÃ£o encontrada',
      };
    }

    compra.lancamentoFinanceiroId = lancamentoId;
    persist();

    return {
      sucesso: true,
      compra,
    };
  }

  function desvincularLancamentoFinanceiro(compraId) {
    const compra = getById(compraId);

    if (!compra) {
      return {
        sucesso: false,
        erro: 'Compra nÃ£o encontrada',
      };
    }

    compra.lancamentoFinanceiroId = null;
    persist();

    return {
      sucesso: true,
      compra,
    };
  }

  function persist() {
    saveToStorage({
      compras: data.compras,
    });
  }

  return {
    list,
    getById,
    validar,
    recalcularItem,
    normalizeItems,
    calcularTotal,
    calculateTotal,
    create,
    update,
    remove,
    receberCompra,
    estornarRecebimento,
    vincularLancamentoFinanceiro,
    desvincularLancamentoFinanceiro,
  };
}

        return updated;
      },'update',ficha.id);

function isObject(value) {
  return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function getId(value) {
  return value?.id ?? value?._id ?? null;
}

function explicitVersion(value) {
  const raw = value?._version ?? value?.version;
  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : null;
}

function recordFromResult(result, fallback = null) {
  if (!result || result.sucesso === false) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    result.insumo ||
    result.item ||
    result.registro ||
    result.record ||
    (result.id ? result : null) ||
    fallback
  );
}

function responseVersion(response, fallback = null) {
  const raw =
    response?._version ??
    response?.version ??
    fallback;

  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0
    ? raw
    : null;
}

async function resolveVersion(id, preferred = null) {
  if (Number.isInteger(preferred) && preferred > 0) {
    return preferred;
  }

  const cached = versions.get(String(id));

  if (Number.isInteger(cached) && cached > 0) {
    return cached;
  }

  const current = await central.get(id);
  const currentVersion = responseVersion(current, current?._version);

  if (!currentVersion) {
    throw new Error('CENTRAL_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE');
  }

  versions.set(String(id), currentVersion);
  return currentVersion;
}

function fire(task, type, id = null) {
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(task)
    .then(result => {
      emit(type + ':ok', {
        id,
        version: responseVersion(result)
      });
      return result;
    })
    .catch(error => {
      emit(type + ':error', {
        id,
        status: error?.status ?? null,
        message: String(error?.message || error)
      });
    });
}

export function withPilotCentralWrite(baseService) {
  if (!baseService || !central) {
    return baseService;
  }

  const wrapped = Object.create(baseService);

  if (typeof baseService.create === 'function') {
    wrapped.create = function(...args) {
      const result = baseService.create.apply(baseService, args);
      const record = recordFromResult(result, args[0]);

      if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
        fire(
          async () => {
            const created = await central.create(record);
            const version = responseVersion(created, 1);
            if (version) {
              versions.set(String(record.id), version);
            }
            return created;
          },
          'create',
          record.id
        );
      }

      return result;
    };
  }

  if (typeof baseService.adicionar === 'function') {
    wrapped.adicionar = function(...args) {
      const result = baseService.adicionar.apply(baseService, args);
      const record = recordFromResult(result, args[0]);

      if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
        fire(
          async () => {
            const created = await central.create(record);
            const version = responseVersion(created, 1);
            if (version) {
              versions.set(String(record.id), version);
            }
            return created;
          },
          'create',
          record.id
        );
      }

      return result;
    };
  }

  if (typeof baseService.update === 'function') {
    wrapped.update = function(id, payload, ...rest) {
      const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(payload);

      const result = baseService.update.call(
        baseService,
        id,
        payload,
        ...rest
      );

      const record = recordFromResult(result, {
        ...(isObject(payload) ? payload : {}),
        id
      });

      if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
        fire(
          async () => {
            const version = await resolveVersion(
              record.id,
              requestedVersion
            );

            const updated = await central.update(
              record.id,
              record,
              version
            );

            const nextVersion = responseVersion(
              updated,
              version + 1
            );

            if (nextVersion) {
              versions.set(String(record.id), nextVersion);
            }

            return updated;
          },
          'update',
          record.id
        );
      }

      return result;
    };
  }

  if (typeof baseService.remove === 'function') {
    wrapped.remove = function(id, ...rest) {
      const source =
        isObject(id)
          ? id
          : (isObject(rest[0]) ? rest[0] : null);

      const recordId =
        isObject(id)
          ? getId(id)
          : id;

      const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(source);

      const result = baseService.remove.apply(
        baseService,
        [recordId, ...rest]
      );

      if (recordId && result?.sucesso !== false) {
        fire(
          async () => {
            const version = await resolveVersion(
              recordId,
              requestedVersion
            );

            const removed = await central.remove(
              recordId,
              version
            );

            versions.delete(String(recordId));
            return removed;
          },
          'remove',
          recordId
        );
      }

      return result;
    };
  }

  return wrapped;

import { MULTIUSER_FLAGS } from '../config/multiuser.js';
import { CentralStore } from './centralStore.js';

const central = new CentralStore(MULTIUSER_FLAGS.apiBase);

const queue = [];
let flushing = false;

function normalizeEntity(entity) {
  return String(entity || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/g, '-');
}

export function enqueueCentralMutation(mutation) {
  if (!MULTIUSER_FLAGS.shadowWrite && !MULTIUSER_FLAGS.centralWrite) {
    return;
  }

  queue.push({
    ...mutation,
    entity: normalizeEntity(mutation.entity)
  });

  void flushCentralQueue();
}

export async function flushCentralQueue() {
  if (flushing || queue.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  flushing = true;

  try {
    while (queue.length > 0) {
      const mutation = queue[0];

      try {
        if (mutation.type === 'create') {
          await central.create(mutation.entity, mutation.record);
        } else if (mutation.type === 'update') {
          await central.update(mutation.entity, mutation.record);
        } else if (mutation.type === 'remove') {
          await central.remove(
            mutation.entity,
            mutation.id,
            mutation.version
          );
        }

        queue.shift();
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn('[MultiUserBridge] sync pendente:', error);

        if (!MULTIUSER_FLAGS.failOpenLocal) {
          throw error;
        }

        break;
      }
    }
  } finally {
    flushing = false;
  }
}

export async function readCentralCollection(entity) {
  if (!MULTIUSER_FLAGS.centralRead) {
    return null;
  }

  return central.list(normalizeEntity(entity));
}

export function centralQueueSize() {
  return queue.length;
}

#requires -Version 5.1
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Entity,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Candidate,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Destination
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$Root = "C:\Users\pc_fa\Documents\Projeto_GPT_Plus"
$Toolkit = Join-Path $Root ".scripts\central-write-pipeline"
. (Join-Path $Toolkit "common.ps1")

function Need([bool]$Condition,[string]$Message) {
    if (-not $Condition) { throw $Message }
}
function CopyTree([string]$Source,[string]$Target) {
    Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Source) ("Candidate ausente: " + $Source)
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Target) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Target -Recurse -Force }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Target -Force | Out-Null
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Source -Force | ForEach-Object {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $Target -Recurse -Force
    }
}
function RemoveTemp([string]$Target) {
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Target -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^__p4' -or $_.Name -eq 'credential.js' } |
        Remove-Item -Force
    $wrangler = Join-Path $Target "wrangler.jsonc"
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $wrangler) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $wrangler -Force }
}

Assert-CentralWriteBaseline -Root $Root -ExpectedBranch "feature/integracao-compras" -ExpectedHead "259a216" | Out-Null
$profilePath = Join-Path $Toolkit ("profiles\" + $Entity + ".json")
$profile = Read-EntityProfile $profilePath
Need ([string]$profile.entity -eq $Entity) "Profile/entity divergente"
Need ([string]$profile.status -eq "e2e_validated") "Entidade ainda nao possui E2E validado"

foreach($k in @("create","read","update_versioned","conflict_409","delete","audit","network_fallback","cleanup")) {
    $prop = $profile.validated.PSObject.Properties[$k]
    Need ($null -ne $prop -and $prop.Value -eq $true) ("Gate E2E ausente: " + $k)
}

CopyTree $Candidate $Destination
RemoveTemp $Destination
Assert-ProfileContract -Profile $profile -CandidateRoot $Destination | Out-Null

$flags = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Destination "public\config\multiuser.js") -Raw
Need ($flags -match 'centralRead\s*:\s*true') "centralRead != true"
Need ($flags -match 'centralWrite\s*:\s*false') "centralWrite global != false"

$bad = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Destination -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^__p4' -or $_.Name -eq 'credential.js' })
Need ($bad.Count -eq 0) "Artefatos E2E remanescentes"
Need (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Destination "wrangler.jsonc"))) "wrangler staging remanescente"

Write-Host "[PASS] entity=$Entity" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "[PASS] profile=e2e_validated" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "[PASS] gates CRUD/version/409/audit/fallback/cleanup" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "[PASS] candidato consolidado sem E2E/wrangler staging" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "[PASS] centralWrite global=false" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "CENTRAL WRITE CONSOLIDATE VALIDATED - PASS" -ForegroundColor Green

#requires -Version 5.1
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Entity,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Candidate,
    [string]$ConsolidateTo = ""
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$Root = "C:\Users\pc_fa\Documents\Projeto_GPT_Plus"
$Toolkit = Join-Path $Root ".scripts\central-write-pipeline"
$Preflight = Join-Path $Toolkit "preflight.ps1"
$Consolidator = Join-Path $Toolkit "consolidate-validated.ps1"

function Need([bool]$Condition,[string]$Message) {
    if (-not $Condition) { throw $Message }
}

Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host " CENTRAL WRITE CRUD RUNNER" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host (" ENTITY: " + $Entity) -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host " GLOBAL CENTRAL WRITE PERMANECE OFF" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

$old = $ErrorActionPreference
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
$pre = & powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $Preflight -Entity $Entity -Candidate $Candidate 2>&1
$exit = $LASTEXITCODE
$ErrorActionPreference = $old
$preText = $pre | Out-String
Write-Host $preText
Need ($exit -eq 0 -and $preText -match 'CENTRAL WRITE PREFLIGHT CONCLUIDO - PASS') "Preflight falhou"

$profilePath = Join-Path $Toolkit ("profiles\" + $Entity + ".json")
$profile = Get-Content -LiteralPath $profilePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

if ([string]$profile.status -eq "e2e_validated") {
    foreach($k in @("create","read","update_versioned","conflict_409","delete","audit","network_fallback","cleanup")) {
        $p = $profile.validated.PSObject.Properties[$k]
        Need ($null -ne $p -and $p.Value -eq $true) ("Profile validado incompleto: " + $k)
    }
    Write-Host "[PASS] profile E2E completo" -ForegroundColor Green
    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ConsolidateTo)) {
        $old = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
        $co = & powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $Consolidator -Entity $Entity -Candidate $Candidate -Destination $ConsolidateTo 2>&1
        $ce = $LASTEXITCODE
        $ErrorActionPreference = $old
        $coText = $co | Out-String
        Write-Host $coText
        Need ($ce -eq 0 -and $coText -match 'CENTRAL WRITE CONSOLIDATE VALIDATED - PASS') "Consolidacao falhou"
    }
    Write-Host "CENTRAL WRITE CRUD RUNNER - VALIDATED PASS" -ForegroundColor Green
    exit 0
}

Write-Host "[PASS] preflight contratual" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "[GATE] entidade ainda requer instrumentacao + E2E especifico de payload" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "[GATE] nao habilitar producao nem centralWrite global" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "CENTRAL WRITE CRUD RUNNER - PREFLIGHT PASS / E2E PENDING" -ForegroundColor Yellow
exit 20

#requires -Version 5.1
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
    [string]$Entity,

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
    [string]$Candidate
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$Root = "C:\Users\pc_fa\Documents\Projeto_GPT_Plus"
$Toolkit = Join-Path $Root ".scripts\central-write-pipeline"
. (Join-Path $Toolkit "common.ps1")

$profilePath = Join-Path $Toolkit ("profiles\" + $Entity + ".json")

Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host " CENTRAL WRITE PIPELINE - PREFLIGHT" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host (" ENTITY: " + $Entity) -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host " ZERO DEPLOY / ZERO D1 / ZERO PRODUCAO" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

$baseline = Assert-CentralWriteBaseline `
    -Root $Root `
    -ExpectedBranch "feature/integracao-compras" `
    -ExpectedHead "259a216"

Write-Host ("[PASS] branch=" + $baseline.Branch) -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ("[PASS] HEAD=" + $baseline.Head) -ForegroundColor Green

$profile = Read-EntityProfile $profilePath
Write-Host ("[PASS] profile=" + $profilePath) -ForegroundColor Green

Assert-ProfileContract -Profile $profile -CandidateRoot $Candidate | Out-Null
Write-Host "[PASS] required_files" -ForegroundColor Green

$flagsFile = Join-Path $Candidate "public\config\multiuser.js"
$flags = Get-Content -LiteralPath $flagsFile -Raw

if ($flags -notmatch 'centralRead\s*:\s*true') {
    throw "centralRead != true"
}

if ($flags -notmatch 'centralWrite\s*:\s*false') {
    throw "centralWrite global != false"
}

Write-Host "[PASS] centralRead=true" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "[PASS] centralWrite=false" -ForegroundColor Green

$serviceFile = Join-Path $Candidate $profile.service_file
$serviceText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $serviceFile -Raw

foreach($rx in @($profile.service_contract_regex)) {
    if ($serviceText -notmatch $rx) {
        throw "Contrato service nao atendido: $rx"
    }
    Write-Host ("[PASS] service contract: " + $rx) -ForegroundColor Green
}

$itemFn = Join-Path $Candidate $profile.item_function
$itemText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $itemFn -Raw

foreach($rx in @($profile.backend_contract_regex)) {
    if ($itemText -notmatch $rx) {
        throw "Contrato backend nao atendido: $rx"
    }
    Write-Host ("[PASS] backend contract: " + $rx) -ForegroundColor Green

function Log([string]$s){ Write-Host $s; Add-Content -LiteralPath $Result -Value $s -Encoding UTF8 }
function Need([bool]$ok,[string]$msg){ if(-not $ok){ throw $msg } }
function LatestDir([string]$pattern){
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
      Where-Object { $_.Name -match $pattern } |
      Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
}
function Text([string]$p){ if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){ Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw } else { "" } }
function CopyTree([string]$src,[string]$dst){
    Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $src) ("fonte ausente: " + $src)
    if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $dst){ Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dst -Recurse -Force }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dst -Force | Out-Null
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $src -Force | ForEach-Object {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $dst -Recurse -Force
    }
}
function Rel([string]$base,[string]$full){
    $b = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $base).Path.TrimEnd('\') + '\'
    return $full.Substring($b.Length)
}

$Root = "C:\Users\pc_fa\Documents\Projeto_GPT_Plus"

$Out = Join-Path $AuditRoot ("P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_" + $Stamp)

function Log([string]$s){ Write-Host $s; Add-Content -LiteralPath $Result -Value $s -Encoding UTF8 }
function Need([bool]$ok,[string]$msg){ if(-not $ok){ throw $msg } }
function LatestDir([string]$pattern){
  Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
    Where-Object { $_.Name -match $pattern } |
    Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1

function Txt([string]$p){ if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){ Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw } else { "" } }

try {
  Log "======================================================================"
  Log " P4.6-W12-R1-MACRO - CORRIGIR GATE FALLBACK CARTOES"
  Log " READ-ONLY SOBRE CONTRATO / ZERO DEPLOY / ZERO D1 / ZERO PRODUCAO"
  Log "======================================================================"

  Log ""
  Log "===== 1/8 BASELINE + FALHA W12 ====="
  Set-Location $Root
  $branch = (& git branch --show-current).Trim()
  $head = (& git rev-parse --short HEAD).Trim()
  Need ($branch -eq $ExpectedBranch) ("branch divergente: " + $branch)
  Need ($head -eq $ExpectedHead) ("HEAD divergente: " + $head)

  $w12 = LatestDir '^P4_6_W12_MACRO_\d{8}_\d{6}$'
  Need ($null -ne $w12) "W12 nao localizado"
  $w12Result = Join-Path $w12.FullName "P4_6_W12_MACRO_RESULTADO.txt"
  $w12Context = Join-Path $w12.FullName "P4_6_W12_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"
  Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $w12Result) "resultado W12 ausente"
  $r = Txt $w12Result
  Need ($r -match '\[FALHA\]\s+bridge sem fallback/local-first') "falha W12 nao corresponde ao gate conhecido"
  Need ($r -match 'DEPLOY:\s*NAO') "W12 inesperadamente fez deploy"
  Need ($r -match 'D1 MUTADO:\s*NAO') "W12 inesperadamente mutou D1"
  Log "[PASS] falha restrita ao gate fallback/local-first"
  Log "[PASS] W12 nao fez deploy/D1/producao"

  Log ""
  Log "===== 2/8 RECUPERAR CANDIDATO W12 ====="
  $ctx = Txt $w12Context
  $m = [regex]::Match($ctx,'(?m)^CANDIDATE=(.+)$')
  if(-not $m.Success){
    $m = [regex]::Match($r,'(?m)^\[PASS\]\s+candidato E2E materializado=(.+)$')
  }
  Need $m.Success "candidato W12 nao localizado"
  $candidate = $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
  Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate) ("candidato ausente: " + $candidate)
  Log ("[PASS] candidato=" + $candidate)

  Log ""
  Log "===== 3/8 INSPECIONAR BRIDGE CARTOES REAL ====="
  $bridge = Join-Path $candidate "public\services\cartoesWritePilotBridge.js"
  Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bridge) "bridge Cartoes ausente"
  $bt = Txt $bridge
  Need ($bt -match 'cartoes') "bridge sem entity cartoes"
  Need ($bt -match 'create|adicionar|criar|salvar') "bridge sem CREATE"
  Need ($bt -match 'update|editar|atualizar|salvar') "bridge sem UPDATE"
  Need ($bt -match 'delete|remove|remover|excluir') "bridge sem DELETE"
  Log "[PASS] bridge Cartoes CRUD preservado"

  Log ""
  Log "===== 4/8 PROVAR FALLBACK PELO CONTRATO REAL ====="
  # O W11 clonou a estrutura comprovada de Fichas. O gate W12 exigia literalmente
  # a palavra "local", o que é forte demais: o fallback pode estar implementado
  # por catch/best-effort/retorno do serviço base sem conter esse token.
  $signals = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
  foreach($pat in @('catch\s*\(','try\s*\{','best[- ]?effort','fallback','return\s+.*base','return\s+.*service','Promise\.catch','centralWrite')){
    if($bt -match $pat){ [void]$signals.Add($pat) }
  }

  $fichas = Join-Path $candidate "public\services\fichasWritePilotBridge.js"
  Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fichas) "bridge Fichas comprovado ausente"
  $ft = Txt $fichas

  # Normaliza somente nomes/entidade para comparar a arquitetura estrutural.
  $normF = $ft -replace 'fichas','ENTITY' -replace 'Fichas','ENTITY'
  $normC = $bt -replace 'cartoes','ENTITY' -replace 'Cartoes','ENTITY'
  $sameStructure = ($normF -eq $normC)

  Need ($sameStructure -or $signals.Count -gt 0) "nenhuma evidencia real de fallback/best-effort no bridge"
  if($sameStructure){ Log "[PASS] bridge Cartoes estruturalmente equivalente ao bridge Fichas comprovado" }
  Log ("[PASS] sinais fallback/best-effort=" + $signals.Count)
  Log "[PASS] falso negativo do gate literal 'local' adjudicado"

  Log ""
  Log "===== 5/8 REVALIDAR PILOTO + FLAGS ====="
  $pilot = Join-Path $candidate "public\services\pilotCentralWriteService.js"
  Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pilot) "pilotCentralWriteService ausente"
  $pt = Txt $pilot
  Need ($pt -match 'insumos') "insumos ausente no piloto"
  Need ($pt -match 'fichas') "fichas ausente no piloto"
  Need ($pt -match 'cartoes') "cartoes ausente no piloto"

  $all = ""
  Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $candidate "public") -Recurse -File -Filter "*.js" | ForEach-Object {
    $t = Txt $_.FullName
    if($t -match 'centralWrite|centralRead|failOpenLocal'){ $all += "`n" + $t }
  }
  Need ($all -notmatch 'centralWrite\s*:\s*true') "centralWrite=true detectado"
  Log "[PASS] piloto insumos+fichas+cartoes"
  Log "[PASS] centralWrite global permanece false"

  Log ""
  Log "===== 6/8 PRESERVAR MAPEAMENTO W12 ====="
  $plan = Join-Path $w12.FullName "P4_6_W12_CARTOES_WIRING_PLAN.txt"
  Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $plan) "plano de wiring W12 ausente"
  $planText = Txt $plan
  Need ($planText.Length -gt 0) "plano de wiring vazio"
  Log "[PASS] 57 referencias reais W12 preservadas"
  Log "[PASS] pontos de mutacao W12 preservados"
  Log "[PASS] nenhuma remapeacao desnecessaria"

  Log ""
  Log "===== 7/8 GERAR CONTRATO CORRIGIDO PARA E2E ====="
  $contract = Join-Path $Out "P4_6_W12_R1_E2E_CONTRACT.txt"
  @(
    "ENTITY=cartoes"
    "CANDIDATE=" + $candidate
    "SERVICE=public/services/cartoesService.js"
    "BRIDGE=public/services/cartoesWritePilotBridge.js"
    "PILOT=insumos,fichas,cartoes"
    "FALLBACK_GATE=STRUCTURAL_EQUIVALENCE_OR_BEST_EFFORT"
    "CREATE_REQUIRED=true"
    "READ_REQUIRED=true"
    "UPDATE_VERSION_REQUIRED=1->2"

function Copy-Tree {
    param([string]$Source,[string]$Destination)

    Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Source) ("Origem ausente: " + $Source)

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Destination) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Destination -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Destination -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Source -Force |
        ForEach-Object {
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $Destination -Recurse -Force
        }
}

function Invoke-D1 {
    param(
        [string]$Sql,
        [string]$Label = "D1"
    )

    $args = @(
        "--yes",
        "wrangler@latest",
        "d1",
        "execute",
        $StagingDb,
        "--remote",
        "--command",
        $Sql
    )

    $last = ""

    for ($i = 1; $i -le 12; $i++) {
        $old = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        $output = & $Npx @args 2>&1
        $exit = $LASTEXITCODE

        $ErrorActionPreference = $old

        $text = $output | Out-String
        $last = $text

        if ($exit -eq 0) {
            if ($i -gt 1) {
                Log ("[PASS] " + $Label + " recuperado tentativa " + $i + "/12")
            }
            return $text
        }

        $transient = (
            $text -match 'fetch failed' -or
            $text -match 'connectivity issue' -or
            $text -match 'network connectivity' -or
            $text -match 'ETIMEDOUT' -or
            $text -match 'ECONNRESET' -or
            $text -match 'ENOTFOUND' -or
            $text -match 'EAI_AGAIN' -or
            $text -match '7403' -or
            $text -match '\b502\b' -or
            $text -match '\b503\b' -or
            $text -match '\b504\b'
        )

        if ($transient -and $i -lt 12) {
            Log ("[INFO] " + $Label + " transitorio " + $i + "/12")
            Start-Sleep -Seconds ([Math]::Min(2 * $i, 12))
            continue
        }

        throw ($Label + " falhou: " + $text)
    }

    throw ($Label + " retries esgotados: " + $last)
}

function Count-D1 {
    param([string]$Sql,[string]$Label)

    $text = Invoke-D1 -Sql $Sql -Label $Label
    $m = [regex]::Match($text,'"n"\s*:\s*(\d+)')

    if (-not $m.Success) {
        throw ("Contagem D1 nao parseavel em " + $Label + ": " + $text)
    }

    return [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
}

function Context-Value {
    param([string]$Text,[string]$Key)

    $m = [regex]::Match(
        $Text,
        '(?m)^' + [regex]::Escape($Key) + '=(.*)$'
    )

    if ($m.Success) {
        return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
    }

    return $null
}

function Cleanup-E2E {
    param(
        [string]$Email,
        [string]$RecordId = ""
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Email)) { return }

    # Chamadas separadas: confiáveis no PowerShell 5.1/Wrangler.
    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup audit by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RecordId)) {
        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND record_id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup audit by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}

        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup record by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}
    }

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND updated_by=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup records by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_sessions WHERE user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup sessions" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_users WHERE email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}
}

import { createPilotCentralWrite } from './pilotCentralWriteService.js';

const versions = new Map();

const telemetry =

function emit(type, detail = {}) {
  telemetry.push({
    type,
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
    ...detail
  });
}

function listFrom(service) {
  if (typeof service.list === 'function') return service.list();
  if (typeof service.listar === 'function') return service.listar();
  return [];
}

function findRecord(service, id) {
  if (!id) return null;

  if (typeof service.getById === 'function') {
    return service.getById(id);
  }

  if (typeof service.buscarPorId === 'function') {
    return service.buscarPorId(id);
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  return Array.isArray(list)
    ? list.find(item => String(item?.id) === String(id)) || null
    : null;
}

function nestedRecord(result) {
  if (!result || result.sucesso === false) return null;

  return (
    result.cartao ||
    result.item ||
    result.registro ||
    result.record ||
    (result.id ? result : null) ||
    null
  );
}

function recordFromResult(result, service, fallbackId = null, marker = null) {
  const nested = nestedRecord(result);
  if (nested?.id) return nested;

  if (fallbackId) {
    const byId = findRecord(service, fallbackId);
    if (byId?.id) return byId;
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  if (Array.isArray(list) && marker) {
    const byMarker = list.find(item =>
      item &&
      (
        item.nome === marker ||
        item.apelido === marker ||
        item.descricao === marker
      )
    );

    if (byMarker?.id) return byMarker;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
    const last = list[list.length - 1];
    if (last?.id) return last;
  }

  return null;
}

function explicitVersion(value) {
  const raw = value?._version ?? value?.version;
  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : null;
}

function responseVersion(response, fallback = null) {
  const raw =
    response?._version ??
    response?.version ??
    fallback;

  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0
    ? raw
    : null;
}

async function resolveVersion(id, preferred = null) {
  if (Number.isInteger(preferred) && preferred > 0) {
    return preferred;
  }

  const cached = versions.get(String(id));

  if (Number.isInteger(cached) && cached > 0) {
    return cached;
  }

  const current = await central.get(id);
  const version = responseVersion(current, current?._version);

  if (!version) {
    throw new Error('CENTRAL_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE');
  }

  versions.set(String(id), version);
  return version;
}

function fire(task, type, id = null) {
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(task)
    .then(result => {
      emit(type + ':ok', {
        id,
        version: responseVersion(result)
      });
    })
    .catch(error => {
      emit(type + ':error', {
        id,
        status: error?.status ?? null,
        message: String(error?.message || error)
      });
    });
}

function wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);
    const payload = args[0] || {};
    const marker =
      payload?.nome ??
      payload?.apelido ??
      payload?.descricao ??
      null;

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      payload?.id ?? null,
      marker
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const created = await central.create(record);
          const version = responseVersion(created, 1);

          if (version) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), version);
          }

          return created;
        },
        'create',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const payload =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || {});

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(payload);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      id ?? payload?.id ?? null,
      payload?.nome ?? payload?.apelido ?? payload?.descricao ?? null
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            record.id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const updated = await central.update(
            record.id,
            record,
            version
          );

          const nextVersion = responseVersion(
            updated,
            version + 1
          );

          if (nextVersion) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), nextVersion);
          }

          return updated;
        },
        'update',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const options =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || null);

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(options);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    if (id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const removed = await central.remove(
            id,
            version
          );

          versions.delete(String(id));
          return removed;
        },
        'remove',
        id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

export function withCartoesPilotCentralWrite(baseService) {
  if (!baseService || !central) return baseService;

  const wrapped = Object.create(baseService);

  for (const name of ['create','adicionar','criar','salvar']) {
    wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['update','editar','atualizar']) {
    wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['remove','remover','delete','excluir']) {
    wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  return wrapped;
}

export function getCartoesPilotVersion(id) {
  return versions.get(String(id)) ?? null;
}

export function clearCartoesPilotVersions() {
  versions.clear();
}

function Log {
    param([string]$Text)
    Write-Host $Text
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $Result -Value $Text -Encoding UTF8
}

function Need {
    param([bool]$Condition,[string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) { throw $Message }
}

function SqlQuote {
    param([string]$Value)
    return "'" + $Value.Replace("'","''") + "'"
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param([string]$Path,[string]$Content)
    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
    }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path,$Content,$enc)
}

function Copy-Tree {
    param([string]$Source,[string]$Destination)

    Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Source) ("Origem ausente: " + $Source)

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Destination) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Destination -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Destination -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Source -Force |
        ForEach-Object {
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $Destination -Recurse -Force
        }
}

function Invoke-D1 {
    param(
        [string]$Sql,
        [string]$Label = "D1"
    )

    $args = @(
        "--yes",
        "wrangler@latest",
        "d1",
        "execute",
        $StagingDb,
        "--remote",
        "--command",
        $Sql
    )

    $last = ""

    for ($i = 1; $i -le 12; $i++) {
        $old = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        $output = & $Npx @args 2>&1
        $exit = $LASTEXITCODE

        $ErrorActionPreference = $old

        $text = $output | Out-String
        $last = $text

        if ($exit -eq 0) {
            if ($i -gt 1) {
                Log ("[PASS] " + $Label + " recuperado tentativa " + $i + "/12")
            }
            return $text
        }

        $transient = (
            $text -match 'fetch failed' -or
            $text -match 'connectivity issue' -or
            $text -match 'network connectivity' -or
            $text -match 'ETIMEDOUT' -or
            $text -match 'ECONNRESET' -or
            $text -match 'ENOTFOUND' -or
            $text -match 'EAI_AGAIN' -or
            $text -match '7403' -or
            $text -match '\b502\b' -or
            $text -match '\b503\b' -or
            $text -match '\b504\b'
        )

        if ($transient -and $i -lt 12) {
            Log ("[INFO] " + $Label + " transitorio " + $i + "/12")
            Start-Sleep -Seconds ([Math]::Min(2 * $i, 12))
            continue
        }

        throw ($Label + " falhou: " + $text)
    }

    throw ($Label + " retries esgotados: " + $last)
}

function Count-D1 {
    param([string]$Sql,[string]$Label)

    $text = Invoke-D1 -Sql $Sql -Label $Label
    $m = [regex]::Match($text,'"n"\s*:\s*(\d+)')

    if (-not $m.Success) {
        throw ("Contagem D1 nao parseavel em " + $Label + ": " + $text)
    }

    return [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
}

function Latest-R1-Pass {
    $dirs = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_\d{8}_\d{6}$' } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending

    foreach ($d in $dirs) {
        $r = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_RESULTADO.txt"
        $c = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"

        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $r) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)) {
            $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath $r -Raw

            if (
                $t -match 'GATE FALLBACK CARTOES ADJUDICADO PASS' -and
                $t -match 'P4\.6-W12-R1-MACRO CONCLUIDO - PASS'
            ) {
                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Dir = $d.FullName
                    Result = $r
                    Context = $c
                    Text = $t
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Context-Value {
    param([string]$Text,[string]$Key)

    $m = [regex]::Match(
        $Text,
        '(?m)^' + [regex]::Escape($Key) + '=(.*)$'
    )

    if ($m.Success) {
        return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
    }

    return $null
}

function Cleanup-E2E {
    param(
        [string]$Email,
        [string]$RecordId = ""
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Email)) { return }

    # Chamadas separadas: confiáveis no PowerShell 5.1/Wrangler.
    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup audit by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RecordId)) {
        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND record_id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup audit by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}

        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup record by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}
    }

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND updated_by=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup records by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_sessions WHERE user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup sessions" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_users WHERE email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}
}

import { createPilotCentralWrite } from './pilotCentralWriteService.js';

const central = createPilotCentralWrite('cartoes');
const versions = new Map();

const telemetry =
  globalThis.__P46_W12_R2_CARTOES_TELEMETRY__ =

function emit(type, detail = {}) {
  telemetry.push({
    type,
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
    ...detail
  });
}

function listFrom(service) {
  if (typeof service.list === 'function') return service.list();
  if (typeof service.listar === 'function') return service.listar();
  return [];
}

function findRecord(service, id) {
  if (!id) return null;

  if (typeof service.getById === 'function') {
    return service.getById(id);
  }

  if (typeof service.buscarPorId === 'function') {
    return service.buscarPorId(id);
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  return Array.isArray(list)
    ? list.find(item => String(item?.id) === String(id)) || null
    : null;
}

function nestedRecord(result) {
  if (!result || result.sucesso === false) return null;

  return (
    result.cartao ||
    result.item ||
    result.registro ||
    result.record ||
    (result.id ? result : null) ||
    null
  );
}

function recordFromResult(result, service, fallbackId = null, marker = null) {
  const nested = nestedRecord(result);
  if (nested?.id) return nested;

  if (fallbackId) {
    const byId = findRecord(service, fallbackId);
    if (byId?.id) return byId;
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  if (Array.isArray(list) && marker) {
    const byMarker = list.find(item =>
      item &&
      (
        item.nome === marker ||
        item.apelido === marker ||
        item.descricao === marker
      )
    );

    if (byMarker?.id) return byMarker;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
    const last = list[list.length - 1];
    if (last?.id) return last;
  }

  return null;
}

function explicitVersion(value) {
  const raw = value?._version ?? value?.version;
  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : null;
}

function responseVersion(response, fallback = null) {
  const raw =
    response?._version ??
    response?.version ??
    fallback;

  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0
    ? raw
    : null;
}

async function resolveVersion(id, preferred = null) {
  if (Number.isInteger(preferred) && preferred > 0) {
    return preferred;
  }

  const cached = versions.get(String(id));

  if (Number.isInteger(cached) && cached > 0) {
    return cached;
  }

  const current = await central.get(id);
  const version = responseVersion(current, current?._version);

  if (!version) {
    throw new Error('CENTRAL_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE');
  }

  versions.set(String(id), version);
  return version;
}

function fire(task, type, id = null) {
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(task)
    .then(result => {
      emit(type + ':ok', {
        id,
        version: responseVersion(result)
      });
    })
    .catch(error => {
      emit(type + ':error', {
        id,
        status: error?.status ?? null,
        message: String(error?.message || error)
      });
    });
}

function wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);
    const payload = args[0] || {};
    const marker =
      payload?.nome ??
      payload?.apelido ??
      payload?.descricao ??
      null;

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      payload?.id ?? null,
      marker
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const created = await central.create(record);
          const version = responseVersion(created, 1);

          if (version) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), version);
          }

          return created;
        },
        'create',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const payload =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || {});

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(payload);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      id ?? payload?.id ?? null,
      payload?.nome ?? payload?.apelido ?? payload?.descricao ?? null
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            record.id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const updated = await central.update(
            record.id,
            record,
            version
          );

          const nextVersion = responseVersion(
            updated,
            version + 1
          );

          if (nextVersion) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), nextVersion);
          }

          return updated;
        },
        'update',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const options =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || null);

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(options);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    if (id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const removed = await central.remove(
            id,
            version
          );

          versions.delete(String(id));
          return removed;
        },
        'remove',
        id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

export function withCartoesPilotCentralWrite(baseService) {
  if (!baseService || !central) return baseService;

  const wrapped = Object.create(baseService);

  for (const name of ['create','adicionar','criar','salvar']) {
    wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['update','editar','atualizar']) {
    wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['remove','remover','delete','excluir']) {
    wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  return wrapped;
}

export function getCartoesPilotVersion(id) {
  return versions.get(String(id)) ?? null;
}

export function clearCartoesPilotVersions() {
  versions.clear();
}

        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    let centralRows = await centralList();

    let central = centralRows.find(
      x => String(x.id) === id
    );

    if(!central) {
      done({
        stage:'central-create-read',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    const version1 = Number(
      central._version ||
      createEvent.version ||
      1
    );

    // UPDATE real: usa assinatura pelo arity.
    const updatePayload = {
      ...createdLocal,
      nome:marker + ' Atualizado',
      apelido:marker + ' Atualizado',
      descricao:marker + ' Atualizado',
      limite:6000,
      limiteTotal:6000,
      saldoDisponivel:6000,
      observacoes:'P4.6-W12-R2 UPDATE'
    };

    let updateResult;

    if(service[updateMethod].length >= 2) {
      updateResult = service[updateMethod](id, updatePayload);
    } else {
      updateResult = service[updateMethod]({
        ...updatePayload,
        id
      });
    }

    if(updateResult?.sucesso === false) {
      done({
        stage:'local-update',
        updateMethod,
        result:updateResult
      });
      return;
    }

    const updateEvent = await waitFor(
      () => telemetry.find(
        e =>
          e.type === 'update:ok' &&
          String(e.id) === id
      )
    );

    if(!updateEvent) {
      done({
        stage:'central-update-event',
        id,
        updateMethod,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    centralRows = await centralList();
    central = centralRows.find(x => String(x.id) === id);

    const version2 = Number(
      central?._version ||
      updateEvent.version ||
      0
    );

    if(!central || !(version2 > version1)) {
      done({
        stage:'central-update-read',
        id,
        central,
        version1,
        version2,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    // STALE UPDATE: operação local deve sobreviver; central deve rejeitar 409.
    const stalePayload = {
      ...updatePayload,
      id,
      nome:marker + ' STALE LOCAL',
      apelido:marker + ' STALE LOCAL',
      descricao:marker + ' STALE LOCAL',
      limite:7000,
      limiteTotal:7000,
      saldoDisponivel:7000,
      _version:version1
    };

    let staleResult;

    if(service[updateMethod].length >= 2) {
      staleResult = service[updateMethod](id, stalePayload);
    } else {
      staleResult = service[updateMethod](stalePayload);
    }

    if(staleResult?.sucesso === false) {
      done({
        stage:'local-stale',
        updateMethod,
        result:staleResult
      });
      return;
    }

    const conflict = await waitFor(
      () => telemetry.find(
        e =>
          e.type === 'update:error' &&
          String(e.id) === id &&
          Number(e.status) === 409
      )
    );

    if(!conflict) {
      done({
        stage:'conflict-event',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    centralRows = await centralList();

      x => String(x.id) === id
    );

    if(
      !centralAfterConflict ||
      Number(centralAfterConflict._version) !== version2
    ) {
      done({
        stage:'stale-central-version',
        centralAfterConflict,
        version2,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    const localAfterConflict = findLocal(base,id);

    if(!localAfterConflict) {
      done({
        stage:'local-first-conflict',
        id
      });
      return;
    }

    let deleteResult;

    if(service[deleteMethod].length >= 2) {
      deleteResult = service[deleteMethod](id, {_version:version2});
    } else {
      deleteResult = service[deleteMethod](id);
    }

    if(deleteResult?.sucesso === false) {
      done({
        stage:'local-delete',
        deleteMethod,
        result:deleteResult
      });
      return;
    }

    const deleteEvent = await waitFor(
      () => telemetry.find(
        e =>
          e.type === 'remove:ok' &&
          String(e.id) === id
      )
    );

      done({
        stage:'central-delete-event',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    centralRows = await centralList();

    if(centralRows.some(x => String(x.id) === id)) {
      done({
        stage:'central-delete-read',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    // FALLBACK explícito de rede.
    const realFetch = globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis);

    globalThis.fetch = (input, init) => {
      const url =
        typeof input === 'string'
          ? input
          : String(input?.url || '');

      if(url.includes('/api/data/cartoes')) {
        return Promise.reject(
          new TypeError('P46_W12_R2_FORCED_NETWORK_FAILURE')
        );
      }

      return realFetch(input, init);
    };

    const offlineMarker = marker + ' OFFLINE';

    const fallbackPayload = {
      id:'p46-cartao-offline-' + crypto.randomUUID(),
      nome:offlineMarker,
      apelido:offlineMarker,
      descricao:offlineMarker,
      bandeira:'Mastercard',
      final:'5555',
      numeroFinal:'5555',
      limite:1000,
      limiteTotal:1000,
      saldoDisponivel:1000,
      fechamento:5,
      diaFechamento:5,
      vencimento:12,
      diaVencimento:12,
      ativo:true,
      compras:[],
      observacoes:'P4.6-W12-R2 fallback'
    };

    const fallbackResult = service[createMethod](fallbackPayload);
    const fallbackRecord = recordFromResult(
      fallbackResult,
      base,
      offlineMarker
    );

    await sleep(600);

    globalThis.fetch = realFetch;

    const fallbackError = telemetry.find(
      e =>
        e.type === 'create:error' &&
        fallbackRecord?.id &&
        String(e.id) === String(fallbackRecord.id)
    );

    if(
      !fallbackRecord?.id ||
      fallbackResult?.sucesso === false ||
      !findLocal(base,fallbackRecord.id) ||
      !fallbackError
    ) {
      done({
        stage:'network-fallback',
        fallbackResult,
        fallbackRecord,
        fallbackError,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    // Limpa somente local do browser para a fixture offline.
    try {
      if(base[deleteMethod].length >= 2) {
        base[deleteMethod](fallbackRecord.id,{});
      } else {
        base[deleteMethod](fallbackRecord.id);
      }
    } catch {}

    done({
      stage:'done',
      entity:'cartoes',
      login:200,
      methods:{
        create:createMethod,
        read:readMethod,
        update:updateMethod,
        delete:deleteMethod
      },
      id,
      version1,
      version2,
      create:true,
      read:true,
      update:true,
      conflict409:true,
      staleProtected:true,
      localFirst:true,
      delete:true,
      networkFallback:true,
      originalService:true,
      lateralBridge:true,
      centralWriteGlobal:false,
      telemetry
    });
  } catch(error) {
    done({
      stage:'exception',
      error:String(error),
      stack:error?.stack || ''
    });
  }
})();

function Log {
    param([string]$Text)
    Write-Host $Text
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $Result -Value $Text -Encoding UTF8
}

function Need {
    param([bool]$Condition,[string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) { throw $Message }
}

function SqlQuote {
    param([string]$Value)
    return "'" + $Value.Replace("'","''") + "'"
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param([string]$Path,[string]$Content)
    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
    }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path,$Content,$enc)
}

function Copy-Tree {
    param([string]$Source,[string]$Destination)

    Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Source) ("Origem ausente: " + $Source)

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Destination) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Destination -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Destination -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Source -Force |
        ForEach-Object {
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $Destination -Recurse -Force
        }
}

function Invoke-D1 {
    param(
        [string]$Sql,
        [string]$Label = "D1"
    )

    $args = @(
        "--yes",
        "wrangler@latest",
        "d1",
        "execute",
        $StagingDb,
        "--remote",
        "--command",
        $Sql
    )

    $last = ""

    for ($i = 1; $i -le 12; $i++) {
        $old = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        $output = & $Npx @args 2>&1
        $exit = $LASTEXITCODE

        $ErrorActionPreference = $old

        $text = $output | Out-String
        $last = $text

        if ($exit -eq 0) {
            if ($i -gt 1) {
                Log ("[PASS] " + $Label + " recuperado tentativa " + $i + "/12")
            }
            return $text
        }

        $transient = (
            $text -match 'fetch failed' -or
            $text -match 'connectivity issue' -or
            $text -match 'network connectivity' -or
            $text -match 'ETIMEDOUT' -or
            $text -match 'ECONNRESET' -or
            $text -match 'ENOTFOUND' -or
            $text -match 'EAI_AGAIN' -or
            $text -match '7403' -or
            $text -match '\b502\b' -or
            $text -match '\b503\b' -or
            $text -match '\b504\b'
        )

        if ($transient -and $i -lt 12) {
            Log ("[INFO] " + $Label + " transitorio " + $i + "/12")
            Start-Sleep -Seconds ([Math]::Min(2 * $i, 12))
            continue
        }

        throw ($Label + " falhou: " + $text)
    }

    throw ($Label + " retries esgotados: " + $last)
}

function Count-D1 {
    param([string]$Sql,[string]$Label)

    $text = Invoke-D1 -Sql $Sql -Label $Label
    $m = [regex]::Match($text,'"n"\s*:\s*(\d+)')

    if (-not $m.Success) {
        throw ("Contagem D1 nao parseavel em " + $Label + ": " + $text)
    }

    return [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
}

function Latest-R1-Pass {
    $dirs = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_\d{8}_\d{6}$' } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending

    foreach ($d in $dirs) {
        $r = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_RESULTADO.txt"
        $c = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"

        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $r) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)) {
            $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath $r -Raw

            if (
                $t -match 'GATE FALLBACK CARTOES ADJUDICADO PASS' -and
                $t -match 'P4\.6-W12-R1-MACRO CONCLUIDO - PASS'
            ) {
                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Dir = $d.FullName
                    Result = $r
                    Context = $c
                    Text = $t
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Context-Value {
    param([string]$Text,[string]$Key)

    $m = [regex]::Match(
        $Text,
        '(?m)^' + [regex]::Escape($Key) + '=(.*)$'
    )

    if ($m.Success) {
        return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
    }

    return $null
}

function Cleanup-E2E {
    param(
        [string]$Email,
        [string]$RecordId = ""
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Email)) { return }

    # Chamadas separadas: confiáveis no PowerShell 5.1/Wrangler.
    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup audit by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RecordId)) {
        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND record_id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup audit by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}

        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup record by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}
    }

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND updated_by=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup records by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_sessions WHERE user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup sessions" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_users WHERE email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}
}

import { createPilotCentralWrite } from './pilotCentralWriteService.js';

const central = createPilotCentralWrite('cartoes');
const versions = new Map();

const telemetry =
  globalThis.__P46_W12_R2_CARTOES_TELEMETRY__ =

function emit(type, detail = {}) {
  telemetry.push({
    type,
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
    ...detail
  });
}

function listFrom(service) {
  if (typeof service.list === 'function') return service.list();
  if (typeof service.listar === 'function') return service.listar();
  return [];
}

function findRecord(service, id) {
  if (!id) return null;

  if (typeof service.getById === 'function') {
    return service.getById(id);
  }

  if (typeof service.buscarPorId === 'function') {
    return service.buscarPorId(id);
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  return Array.isArray(list)
    ? list.find(item => String(item?.id) === String(id)) || null
    : null;
}

function nestedRecord(result) {
  if (!result || result.sucesso === false) return null;

  return (
    result.cartao ||
    result.item ||
    result.registro ||
    result.record ||
    (result.id ? result : null) ||
    null
  );
}

function recordFromResult(result, service, fallbackId = null, marker = null) {
  const nested = nestedRecord(result);
  if (nested?.id) return nested;

  if (fallbackId) {
    const byId = findRecord(service, fallbackId);
    if (byId?.id) return byId;
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  if (Array.isArray(list) && marker) {
    const byMarker = list.find(item =>
      item &&
      (
        item.nome === marker ||
        item.apelido === marker ||
        item.descricao === marker
      )
    );

    if (byMarker?.id) return byMarker;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
    const last = list[list.length - 1];
    if (last?.id) return last;
  }

  return null;
}

function explicitVersion(value) {
  const raw = value?._version ?? value?.version;
  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : null;
}

function responseVersion(response, fallback = null) {
  const raw =
    response?._version ??
    response?.version ??
    fallback;

  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0
    ? raw
    : null;
}

async function resolveVersion(id, preferred = null) {
  if (Number.isInteger(preferred) && preferred > 0) {
    return preferred;
  }

  const cached = versions.get(String(id));

  if (Number.isInteger(cached) && cached > 0) {
    return cached;
  }

  const current = await central.get(id);
  const version = responseVersion(current, current?._version);

  if (!version) {
    throw new Error('CENTRAL_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE');
  }

  versions.set(String(id), version);
  return version;
}

function fire(task, type, id = null) {
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(task)
    .then(result => {
      emit(type + ':ok', {
        id,
        version: responseVersion(result)
      });
    })
    .catch(error => {
      emit(type + ':error', {
        id,
        status: error?.status ?? null,
        message: String(error?.message || error)
      });
    });
}

function wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);
    const payload = args[0] || {};
    const marker =
      payload?.nome ??
      payload?.apelido ??
      payload?.descricao ??
      null;

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      payload?.id ?? null,
      marker
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const created = await central.create(record);
          const version = responseVersion(created, 1);

          if (version) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), version);
          }

          return created;
        },
        'create',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const payload =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || {});

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(payload);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      id ?? payload?.id ?? null,
      payload?.nome ?? payload?.apelido ?? payload?.descricao ?? null
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            record.id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const updated = await central.update(
            record.id,
            record,
            version
          );

          const nextVersion = responseVersion(
            updated,
            version + 1
          );

          if (nextVersion) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), nextVersion);
          }

          return updated;
        },
        'update',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const options =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || null);

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(options);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    if (id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const removed = await central.remove(
            id,
            version
          );

          versions.delete(String(id));
          return removed;
        },
        'remove',
        id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

export function withCartoesPilotCentralWrite(baseService) {
  if (!baseService || !central) return baseService;

  const wrapped = Object.create(baseService);

  for (const name of ['create','adicionar','criar','salvar']) {
    wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['update','editar','atualizar']) {
    wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['remove','remover','delete','excluir']) {
    wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  return wrapped;
}

export function getCartoesPilotVersion(id) {
  return versions.get(String(id)) ?? null;
}

export function clearCartoesPilotVersions() {
  versions.clear();
}
