    if(!createdLocal?.id || createResult?.sucesso === false) {
      done({
        stage:'local-create',
        createMethod,
        result:createResult,
        localList:listLocal(base)
      });
      return;
    }

    const id = String(createdLocal.id);

    const createEvent = await waitFor(
      () => telemetry.find(
        e =>
          e.type === 'create:ok' &&
          String(e.id) === id
      )
    );

    if(!createEvent) {
      done({
        stage:'central-create-event',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    let centralRows = await centralList();

    let central = centralRows.find(
      x => String(x.id) === id
    );

    if(!central) {
      done({
        stage:'central-create-read',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    const version1 = Number(
      central._version ||
      createEvent.version ||
      1
    );

    // UPDATE real: usa assinatura pelo arity.
    const updatePayload = {
      ...createdLocal,
      nome:marker + ' Atualizado',
      apelido:marker + ' Atualizado',
      descricao:marker + ' Atualizado',
      limite:6000,
      limiteTotal:6000,
      saldoDisponivel:6000,
      observacoes:'P4.6-W12-R2 UPDATE'
    };

    let updateResult;

    if(service[updateMethod].length >= 2) {
      updateResult = service[updateMethod](id, updatePayload);
    } else {
      updateResult = service[updateMethod]({
        ...updatePayload,
        id
      });
    }

    if(updateResult?.sucesso === false) {
      done({
        stage:'local-update',
        updateMethod,
        result:updateResult
      });
      return;
    }

    const updateEvent = await waitFor(
      () => telemetry.find(
        e =>
          e.type === 'update:ok' &&
          String(e.id) === id
      )
    );

    if(!updateEvent) {
      done({
        stage:'central-update-event',
        id,
        updateMethod,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    centralRows = await centralList();
    central = centralRows.find(x => String(x.id) === id);

    const version2 = Number(
      central?._version ||
      updateEvent.version ||
      0
    );

    if(!central || !(version2 > version1)) {
      done({
        stage:'central-update-read',
        id,
        central,
        version1,
        version2,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    // STALE UPDATE: operação local deve sobreviver; central deve rejeitar 409.
    const stalePayload = {
      ...updatePayload,
      id,
      nome:marker + ' STALE LOCAL',
      apelido:marker + ' STALE LOCAL',
      descricao:marker + ' STALE LOCAL',
      limite:7000,
      limiteTotal:7000,
      saldoDisponivel:7000,
      _version:version1
    };

    let staleResult;

    if(service[updateMethod].length >= 2) {
      staleResult = service[updateMethod](id, stalePayload);
    } else {
      staleResult = service[updateMethod](stalePayload);
    }

    if(staleResult?.sucesso === false) {
      done({
        stage:'local-stale',
        updateMethod,
        result:staleResult
      });
      return;
    }

      () => telemetry.find(
        e =>
          e.type === 'update:error' &&
          String(e.id) === id &&
          Number(e.status) === 409
      )
    );

    if(!conflict) {
      done({
        stage:'conflict-event',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    centralRows = await centralList();
    const centralAfterConflict = centralRows.find(
      x => String(x.id) === id
    );

    if(
      !centralAfterConflict ||
      Number(centralAfterConflict._version) !== version2
    ) {
      done({
        stage:'stale-central-version',
        centralAfterConflict,
        version2,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    const localAfterConflict = findLocal(base,id);

    if(!localAfterConflict) {
      done({
        stage:'local-first-conflict',
        id
      });
      return;
    }

    // DELETE real. Bridge mantém a versão central v2 em cache.

    if(service[deleteMethod].length >= 2) {
      deleteResult = service[deleteMethod](id, {_version:version2});
    } else {
      deleteResult = service[deleteMethod](id);
    }

    if(deleteResult?.sucesso === false) {
      done({
        stage:'local-delete',
        deleteMethod,
        result:deleteResult
      });
      return;
    }

    const deleteEvent = await waitFor(
      () => telemetry.find(
        e =>
          e.type === 'remove:ok' &&
          String(e.id) === id

        stage:'central-delete-event',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    if(centralRows.some(x => String(x.id) === id)) {
      done({
        stage:'central-delete-read',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    // FALLBACK explícito de rede.
    const realFetch = globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis);

    globalThis.fetch = (input, init) => {
      const url =
        typeof input === 'string'
          ? input
          : String(input?.url || '');

      if(url.includes('/api/data/cartoes')) {
        return Promise.reject(
          new TypeError('P46_W12_R2_FORCED_NETWORK_FAILURE')
        );
      }

      return realFetch(input, init);
    };

    const offlineMarker = marker + ' OFFLINE';

    const fallbackPayload = {
      id:'p46-cartao-offline-' + crypto.randomUUID(),
      nome:offlineMarker,
      apelido:offlineMarker,
      descricao:offlineMarker,
      bandeira:'Mastercard',
      final:'5555',
      numeroFinal:'5555',
      limite:1000,
      limiteTotal:1000,
      saldoDisponivel:1000,
      fechamento:5,
      diaFechamento:5,
      vencimento:12,
      diaVencimento:12,
      ativo:true,
      compras:[],
      observacoes:'P4.6-W12-R2 fallback'
    };

    const fallbackResult = service[createMethod](fallbackPayload);
    const fallbackRecord = recordFromResult(
      fallbackResult,
      base,
      offlineMarker
    );

    await sleep(600);

    globalThis.fetch = realFetch;

    const fallbackError = telemetry.find(
      e =>
        e.type === 'create:error' &&
        fallbackRecord?.id &&
        String(e.id) === String(fallbackRecord.id)

      !fallbackRecord?.id ||
      fallbackResult?.sucesso === false ||
      !findLocal(base,fallbackRecord.id) ||
      !fallbackError
    ) {
      done({
        stage:'network-fallback',
        fallbackResult,
        fallbackRecord,
        fallbackError,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    // Limpa somente local do browser para a fixture offline.
    try {
      if(base[deleteMethod].length >= 2) {
        base[deleteMethod](fallbackRecord.id,{});
      } else {
        base[deleteMethod](fallbackRecord.id);
      }
    } catch {}

    done({
      stage:'done',
      entity:'cartoes',
      login:200,
      methods:{
        create:createMethod,
        read:readMethod,
        update:updateMethod,
        delete:deleteMethod
      },

      read:true,

      localFirst:true,

      telemetry
    });
  } catch(error) {
    done({
      stage:'exception',
      error:String(error),
      stack:error?.stack || ''
    });
  }
})();

function Log {
    param([string]$Text)
    Write-Host $Text
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $Result -Value $Text -Encoding UTF8
}

function Need {
    param([bool]$Condition,[string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) { throw $Message }
}

function SqlQuote {
    param([string]$Value)
    return "'" + $Value.Replace("'","''") + "'"
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param([string]$Path,[string]$Content)
    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
    }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path,$Content,$enc)
}

function Copy-Tree {
    param([string]$Source,[string]$Destination)

    Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Source) ("Origem ausente: " + $Source)

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Destination) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Destination -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Destination -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Source -Force |
        ForEach-Object {
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $Destination -Recurse -Force
        }
}

function Invoke-D1 {
    param(
        [string]$Sql,
        [string]$Label = "D1"
    )

    $args = @(
        "--yes",
        "wrangler@latest",
        "d1",
        "execute",
        $StagingDb,
        "--remote",
        "--command",
        $Sql
    )

    $last = ""

    for ($i = 1; $i -le 12; $i++) {
        $old = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        $output = & $Npx @args 2>&1
        $exit = $LASTEXITCODE

        $ErrorActionPreference = $old

        $text = $output | Out-String
        $last = $text

        if ($exit -eq 0) {
            if ($i -gt 1) {
                Log ("[PASS] " + $Label + " recuperado tentativa " + $i + "/12")
            }
            return $text
        }

        $transient = (
            $text -match 'fetch failed' -or
            $text -match 'connectivity issue' -or
            $text -match 'network connectivity' -or
            $text -match 'ETIMEDOUT' -or
            $text -match 'ECONNRESET' -or
            $text -match 'ENOTFOUND' -or
            $text -match 'EAI_AGAIN' -or
            $text -match '7403' -or
            $text -match '\b502\b' -or
            $text -match '\b503\b' -or
            $text -match '\b504\b'
        )

        if ($transient -and $i -lt 12) {
            Log ("[INFO] " + $Label + " transitorio " + $i + "/12")
            Start-Sleep -Seconds ([Math]::Min(2 * $i, 12))
            continue
        }

        throw ($Label + " falhou: " + $text)
    }

    throw ($Label + " retries esgotados: " + $last)
}

function Count-D1 {
    param([string]$Sql,[string]$Label)

    $text = Invoke-D1 -Sql $Sql -Label $Label
    $m = [regex]::Match($text,'"n"\s*:\s*(\d+)')

    if (-not $m.Success) {
        throw ("Contagem D1 nao parseavel em " + $Label + ": " + $text)
    }

    return [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
}

function Latest-R1-Pass {
    $dirs = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_\d{8}_\d{6}$' } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending

    foreach ($d in $dirs) {
        $r = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_RESULTADO.txt"
        $c = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"

        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $r) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)) {
            $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath $r -Raw

            if (
                $t -match 'GATE FALLBACK CARTOES ADJUDICADO PASS' -and
                $t -match 'P4\.6-W12-R1-MACRO CONCLUIDO - PASS'
            ) {
                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Dir = $d.FullName
                    Result = $r
                    Context = $c
                    Text = $t
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Context-Value {
    param([string]$Text,[string]$Key)

    $m = [regex]::Match(
        $Text,
        '(?m)^' + [regex]::Escape($Key) + '=(.*)$'
    )

    if ($m.Success) {
        return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
    }

    return $null
}

function Cleanup-E2E {
    param(
        [string]$Email,
        [string]$RecordId = ""
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Email)) { return }

    # Chamadas separadas: confiáveis no PowerShell 5.1/Wrangler.
    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup audit by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RecordId)) {
        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND record_id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup audit by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}

        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup record by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}
    }

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND updated_by=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup records by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_sessions WHERE user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup sessions" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_users WHERE email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}
}

import { createPilotCentralWrite } from './pilotCentralWriteService.js';

const central = createPilotCentralWrite('cartoes');
const versions = new Map();

const telemetry =

function emit(type, detail = {}) {
  telemetry.push({
    type,
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
    ...detail
  });
}

function listFrom(service) {
  if (typeof service.list === 'function') return service.list();
  if (typeof service.listar === 'function') return service.listar();
  return [];
}

function findRecord(service, id) {
  if (!id) return null;

  if (typeof service.getById === 'function') {
    return service.getById(id);
  }

  if (typeof service.buscarPorId === 'function') {
    return service.buscarPorId(id);
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  return Array.isArray(list)
    ? list.find(item => String(item?.id) === String(id)) || null
    : null;
}

function nestedRecord(result) {
  if (!result || result.sucesso === false) return null;

  return (
    result.cartao ||
    result.item ||
    result.registro ||
    result.record ||
    (result.id ? result : null) ||
    null
  );
}

function recordFromResult(result, service, fallbackId = null, marker = null) {
  const nested = nestedRecord(result);
  if (nested?.id) return nested;

  if (fallbackId) {
    const byId = findRecord(service, fallbackId);
    if (byId?.id) return byId;
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  if (Array.isArray(list) && marker) {
    const byMarker = list.find(item =>
      item &&
      (
        item.nome === marker ||
        item.apelido === marker ||
        item.descricao === marker
      )
    );

    if (byMarker?.id) return byMarker;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
    const last = list[list.length - 1];
    if (last?.id) return last;
  }

  return null;
}

function explicitVersion(value) {
  const raw = value?._version ?? value?.version;
  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : null;
}

function responseVersion(response, fallback = null) {
  const raw =
    response?._version ??
    response?.version ??
    fallback;

  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0
    ? raw
    : null;
}

async function resolveVersion(id, preferred = null) {
  if (Number.isInteger(preferred) && preferred > 0) {
    return preferred;
  }

  const cached = versions.get(String(id));

  if (Number.isInteger(cached) && cached > 0) {
    return cached;
  }

  const current = await central.get(id);
  const version = responseVersion(current, current?._version);

  if (!version) {
    throw new Error('CENTRAL_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE');
  }

  versions.set(String(id), version);
  return version;
}

function fire(task, type, id = null) {
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(task)
    .then(result => {
      emit(type + ':ok', {
        id,
        version: responseVersion(result)
      });
    })
    .catch(error => {
      emit(type + ':error', {
        id,
        status: error?.status ?? null,
        message: String(error?.message || error)
      });
    });
}

function wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);
    const payload = args[0] || {};
    const marker =
      payload?.nome ??
      payload?.apelido ??
      payload?.descricao ??
      null;

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      payload?.id ?? null,
      marker
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const created = await central.create(record);
          const version = responseVersion(created, 1);

          if (version) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), version);
          }

          return created;
        },
        'create',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const payload =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || {});

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(payload);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      id ?? payload?.id ?? null,
      payload?.nome ?? payload?.apelido ?? payload?.descricao ?? null
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            record.id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const updated = await central.update(
            record.id,
            record,
            version
          );

          const nextVersion = responseVersion(
            updated,
            version + 1
          );

          if (nextVersion) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), nextVersion);
          }

          return updated;
        },
        'update',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const options =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || null);

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(options);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    if (id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const removed = await central.remove(
            id,
            version
          );

          versions.delete(String(id));
          return removed;
        },
        'remove',
        id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

export function withCartoesPilotCentralWrite(baseService) {
  if (!baseService || !central) return baseService;

  const wrapped = Object.create(baseService);

  for (const name of ['create','adicionar','criar','salvar']) {
    wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['update','editar','atualizar']) {
    wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['remove','remover','delete','excluir']) {
    wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  return wrapped;
}

export function getCartoesPilotVersion(id) {
  return versions.get(String(id)) ?? null;
}

export function clearCartoesPilotVersions() {
  versions.clear();
}

      bandeira:'Visa',
      final:'4242',
      numeroFinal:'4242',
      limite:5000,
      limiteTotal:5000,
      saldoDisponivel:5000,
      fechamento:10,
      diaFechamento:10,
      vencimento:17,
      diaVencimento:17,
      ativo:true,
      compras:[],
      observacoes:'P4.6-W12-R2'
    };

    const createResult = service[createMethod](createPayload);
    const createdLocal = recordFromResult(
      createResult,
      base,
      marker
    );

    if(!createdLocal?.id || createResult?.sucesso === false) {
      done({
        stage:'local-create',
        createMethod,
        result:createResult,
        localList:listLocal(base)
      });
      return;
    }

    const id = String(createdLocal.id);

    const createEvent = await waitFor(
      () => telemetry.find(
        e =>
          e.type === 'create:ok' &&
          String(e.id) === id
      )
    );

    if(!createEvent) {
      done({
        stage:'central-create-event',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    let centralRows = await centralList();

    let central = centralRows.find(
      x => String(x.id) === id
    );

    if(!central) {
      done({
        stage:'central-create-read',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    const version1 = Number(
      central._version ||
      createEvent.version ||
      1
    );

    // UPDATE real: usa assinatura pelo arity.
    const updatePayload = {
      ...createdLocal,
      nome:marker + ' Atualizado',
      apelido:marker + ' Atualizado',
      descricao:marker + ' Atualizado',
      limite:6000,
      limiteTotal:6000,
      saldoDisponivel:6000,
      observacoes:'P4.6-W12-R2 UPDATE'
    };

    let updateResult;

    if(service[updateMethod].length >= 2) {
      updateResult = service[updateMethod](id, updatePayload);
    } else {
      updateResult = service[updateMethod]({
        ...updatePayload,
        id
      });
    }

    if(updateResult?.sucesso === false) {
      done({
        stage:'local-update',
        updateMethod,
        result:updateResult
      });
      return;
    }

    const updateEvent = await waitFor(
      () => telemetry.find(
        e =>
          e.type === 'update:ok' &&
          String(e.id) === id
      )
    );

    if(!updateEvent) {
      done({
        stage:'central-update-event',
        id,
        updateMethod,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    centralRows = await centralList();
    central = centralRows.find(x => String(x.id) === id);

    const version2 = Number(
      central?._version ||
      updateEvent.version ||
      0
    );

    if(!central || !(version2 > version1)) {
      done({
        stage:'central-update-read',
        id,
        central,
        version1,
        version2,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    // STALE UPDATE: operação local deve sobreviver; central deve rejeitar 409.
    const stalePayload = {
      ...updatePayload,
      id,
      nome:marker + ' STALE LOCAL',
      apelido:marker + ' STALE LOCAL',
      descricao:marker + ' STALE LOCAL',
      limite:7000,
      limiteTotal:7000,
      saldoDisponivel:7000,
      _version:version1
    };

    let staleResult;

    if(service[updateMethod].length >= 2) {
      staleResult = service[updateMethod](id, stalePayload);
    } else {
      staleResult = service[updateMethod](stalePayload);
    }

    if(staleResult?.sucesso === false) {
      done({
        stage:'local-stale',
        updateMethod,
        result:staleResult
      });
      return;
    }

    const conflict = await waitFor(
      () => telemetry.find(
        e =>
          e.type === 'update:error' &&
          String(e.id) === id &&
          Number(e.status) === 409
      )
    );

    if(!conflict) {
      done({
        stage:'conflict-event',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    centralRows = await centralList();
    const centralAfterConflict = centralRows.find(
      x => String(x.id) === id
    );

    if(
      !centralAfterConflict ||
      Number(centralAfterConflict._version) !== version2
    ) {
      done({
        stage:'stale-central-version',
        centralAfterConflict,
        version2,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    const localAfterConflict = findLocal(base,id);

    if(!localAfterConflict) {
      done({
        stage:'local-first-conflict',
        id
      });
      return;
    }

    // DELETE real. Bridge mantém a versão central v2 em cache.
    let deleteResult;

    if(service[deleteMethod].length >= 2) {
      deleteResult = service[deleteMethod](id, {_version:version2});
    } else {
      deleteResult = service[deleteMethod](id);
    }

    if(deleteResult?.sucesso === false) {
      done({
        stage:'local-delete',
        deleteMethod,
        result:deleteResult
      });
      return;
    }

    const deleteEvent = await waitFor(
      () => telemetry.find(
        e =>
          e.type === 'remove:ok' &&
          String(e.id) === id
      )
    );

    if(!deleteEvent) {
      done({
        stage:'central-delete-event',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    centralRows = await centralList();

    if(centralRows.some(x => String(x.id) === id)) {
      done({
        stage:'central-delete-read',
        id,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    // FALLBACK explícito de rede.
    const realFetch = globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis);

    globalThis.fetch = (input, init) => {
      const url =
        typeof input === 'string'
          ? input
          : String(input?.url || '');

      if(url.includes('/api/data/cartoes')) {
        return Promise.reject(
          new TypeError('P46_W12_R2_FORCED_NETWORK_FAILURE')
        );
      }

      return realFetch(input, init);
    };

    const offlineMarker = marker + ' OFFLINE';

    const fallbackPayload = {
      id:'p46-cartao-offline-' + crypto.randomUUID(),
      nome:offlineMarker,
      apelido:offlineMarker,
      descricao:offlineMarker,
      bandeira:'Mastercard',
      final:'5555',
      numeroFinal:'5555',
      limite:1000,
      limiteTotal:1000,
      saldoDisponivel:1000,
      fechamento:5,
      diaFechamento:5,
      vencimento:12,
      diaVencimento:12,
      ativo:true,
      compras:[],
      observacoes:'P4.6-W12-R2 fallback'
    };

    const fallbackResult = service[createMethod](fallbackPayload);
    const fallbackRecord = recordFromResult(
      fallbackResult,
      base,
      offlineMarker
    );

    await sleep(600);

    globalThis.fetch = realFetch;

    const fallbackError = telemetry.find(
      e =>
        e.type === 'create:error' &&
        fallbackRecord?.id &&
        String(e.id) === String(fallbackRecord.id)
    );

    if(
      !fallbackRecord?.id ||
      fallbackResult?.sucesso === false ||
      !findLocal(base,fallbackRecord.id) ||
      !fallbackError
    ) {
      done({
        stage:'network-fallback',
        fallbackResult,
        fallbackRecord,
        fallbackError,
        telemetry
      });
      return;
    }

    // Limpa somente local do browser para a fixture offline.
    try {
      if(base[deleteMethod].length >= 2) {
        base[deleteMethod](fallbackRecord.id,{});
      } else {
        base[deleteMethod](fallbackRecord.id);
      }
    } catch {}

    done({
      stage:'done',
      entity:'cartoes',
      login:200,
      methods:{
        create:createMethod,
        read:readMethod,
        update:updateMethod,
        delete:deleteMethod
      },
      id,
      version1,
      version2,
      create:true,
      read:true,
      update:true,
      conflict409:true,
      staleProtected:true,
      localFirst:true,
      delete:true,
      networkFallback:true,
      originalService:true,
      lateralBridge:true,
      centralWriteGlobal:false,
      telemetry
    });
  } catch(error) {
    done({
      stage:'exception',
      error:String(error),
      stack:error?.stack || ''
    });
  }
})();

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param([string]$Path,[string]$Content)
    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
    }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path,$Content,$enc)
}

function Copy-Tree {
    param([string]$Source,[string]$Destination)

    Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Source) ("Origem ausente: " + $Source)

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Destination) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Destination -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Destination -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Source -Force |
        ForEach-Object {
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $Destination -Recurse -Force
        }
}

function Invoke-D1 {
    param(
        [string]$Sql,
        [string]$Label = "D1"
    )

    $args = @(
        "--yes",
        "wrangler@latest",
        "d1",
        "execute",
        $StagingDb,
        "--remote",
        "--command",
        $Sql
    )

    $last = ""

    for ($i = 1; $i -le 12; $i++) {
        $old = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        $output = & $Npx @args 2>&1
        $exit = $LASTEXITCODE

        $ErrorActionPreference = $old

        $text = $output | Out-String
        $last = $text

        if ($exit -eq 0) {
            if ($i -gt 1) {
                Log ("[PASS] " + $Label + " recuperado tentativa " + $i + "/12")
            }
            return $text
        }

        $transient = (
            $text -match 'fetch failed' -or
            $text -match 'connectivity issue' -or
            $text -match 'network connectivity' -or
            $text -match 'ETIMEDOUT' -or
            $text -match 'ECONNRESET' -or
            $text -match 'ENOTFOUND' -or
            $text -match 'EAI_AGAIN' -or
            $text -match '7403' -or
            $text -match '\b502\b' -or
            $text -match '\b503\b' -or
            $text -match '\b504\b'
        )

        if ($transient -and $i -lt 12) {
            Log ("[INFO] " + $Label + " transitorio " + $i + "/12")
            Start-Sleep -Seconds ([Math]::Min(2 * $i, 12))
            continue
        }

        throw ($Label + " falhou: " + $text)
    }

    throw ($Label + " retries esgotados: " + $last)
}

function Count-D1 {
    param([string]$Sql,[string]$Label)

    $text = Invoke-D1 -Sql $Sql -Label $Label
    $m = [regex]::Match($text,'"n"\s*:\s*(\d+)')

    if (-not $m.Success) {
        throw ("Contagem D1 nao parseavel em " + $Label + ": " + $text)
    }

    return [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
}

function Latest-R1-Pass {
    $dirs = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_\d{8}_\d{6}$' } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending

    foreach ($d in $dirs) {
        $r = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_RESULTADO.txt"
        $c = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"

        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $r) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)) {
            $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath $r -Raw

            if (
                $t -match 'GATE FALLBACK CARTOES ADJUDICADO PASS' -and
                $t -match 'P4\.6-W12-R1-MACRO CONCLUIDO - PASS'
            ) {
                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Dir = $d.FullName
                    Result = $r
                    Context = $c
                    Text = $t
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Context-Value {
    param([string]$Text,[string]$Key)

    $m = [regex]::Match(
        $Text,
        '(?m)^' + [regex]::Escape($Key) + '=(.*)$'
    )

    if ($m.Success) {
        return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
    }

    return $null
}

function Cleanup-E2E {
    param(
        [string]$Email,
        [string]$RecordId = ""
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Email)) { return }

    # Chamadas separadas: confiáveis no PowerShell 5.1/Wrangler.
    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup audit by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RecordId)) {
        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND record_id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup audit by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}

        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup record by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}
    }

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND updated_by=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup records by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_sessions WHERE user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup sessions" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_users WHERE email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}
}

function listFrom(service) {
  if (typeof service.list === 'function') return service.list();
  if (typeof service.listar === 'function') return service.listar();
  return [];
}

function findRecord(service, id) {
  if (!id) return null;

  if (typeof service.getById === 'function') {
    return service.getById(id);
  }

  if (typeof service.buscarPorId === 'function') {
    return service.buscarPorId(id);
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  return Array.isArray(list)
    ? list.find(item => String(item?.id) === String(id)) || null
    : null;
}

function nestedRecord(result) {
  if (!result || result.sucesso === false) return null;

  return (
    result.cartao ||
    result.item ||
    result.registro ||
    result.record ||
    (result.id ? result : null) ||
    null
  );
}

function recordFromResult(result, service, fallbackId = null, marker = null) {
  const nested = nestedRecord(result);
  if (nested?.id) return nested;

  if (fallbackId) {
    const byId = findRecord(service, fallbackId);
    if (byId?.id) return byId;
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  if (Array.isArray(list) && marker) {
    const byMarker = list.find(item =>
      item &&
      (
        item.nome === marker ||
        item.apelido === marker ||
        item.descricao === marker
      )
    );

    if (byMarker?.id) return byMarker;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
    const last = list[list.length - 1];
    if (last?.id) return last;
  }

  return null;
}

function explicitVersion(value) {
  const raw = value?._version ?? value?.version;
  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : null;
}

function responseVersion(response, fallback = null) {
  const raw =
    response?._version ??
    response?.version ??
    fallback;

  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0
    ? raw
    : null;
}

async function resolveVersion(id, preferred = null) {
  if (Number.isInteger(preferred) && preferred > 0) {
    return preferred;
  }

  const cached = versions.get(String(id));

  if (Number.isInteger(cached) && cached > 0) {
    return cached;
  }

  const current = await central.get(id);
  const version = responseVersion(current, current?._version);

  if (!version) {
    throw new Error('CENTRAL_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE');
  }

  versions.set(String(id), version);
  return version;
}

function fire(task, type, id = null) {
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(task)
    .then(result => {
      emit(type + ':ok', {
        id,
        version: responseVersion(result)
      });
    })
    .catch(error => {
      emit(type + ':error', {
        id,
        status: error?.status ?? null,
        message: String(error?.message || error)
      });
    });
}

function wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);
    const payload = args[0] || {};
    const marker =
      payload?.nome ??
      payload?.apelido ??
      payload?.descricao ??
      null;

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      payload?.id ?? null,
      marker
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const created = await central.create(record);
          const version = responseVersion(created, 1);

          if (version) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), version);
          }

          return created;
        },
        'create',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const payload =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || {});

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(payload);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      id ?? payload?.id ?? null,
      payload?.nome ?? payload?.apelido ?? payload?.descricao ?? null
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            record.id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const updated = await central.update(
            record.id,
            record,
            version
          );

          const nextVersion = responseVersion(
            updated,
            version + 1
          );

          if (nextVersion) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), nextVersion);
          }

          return updated;
        },
        'update',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const options =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || null);

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(options);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    if (id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const removed = await central.remove(
            id,
            version
          );

          versions.delete(String(id));
          return removed;
        },
        'remove',
        id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

export function withCartoesPilotCentralWrite(baseService) {
  if (!baseService || !central) return baseService;

  const wrapped = Object.create(baseService);

  for (const name of ['create','adicionar','criar','salvar']) {
    wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['update','editar','atualizar']) {
    wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['remove','remover','delete','excluir']) {
    wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  return wrapped;
}

export function getCartoesPilotVersion(id) {
  return versions.get(String(id)) ?? null;
}

export function clearCartoesPilotVersions() {
  versions.clear();
}

function Log {
    param([string]$Text)
    Write-Host $Text
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $Result -Value $Text -Encoding UTF8

function Need {
    param([bool]$Condition,[string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) { throw $Message }
}

function SqlQuote {
    param([string]$Value)
    return "'" + $Value.Replace("'","''") + "'"
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param([string]$Path,[string]$Content)
    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
    }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path,$Content,$enc)
}

function Copy-Tree {
    param([string]$Source,[string]$Destination)

    Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Source) ("Origem ausente: " + $Source)

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Destination) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Destination -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Destination -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Source -Force |
        ForEach-Object {
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $Destination -Recurse -Force
        }
}

function Invoke-D1 {
    param(
        [string]$Sql,
        [string]$Label = "D1"
    )

    $args = @(
        "--yes",
        "wrangler@latest",
        "d1",
        "execute",
        $StagingDb,
        "--remote",
        "--command",
        $Sql
    )

    $last = ""

    for ($i = 1; $i -le 12; $i++) {
        $old = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        $output = & $Npx @args 2>&1
        $exit = $LASTEXITCODE

        $ErrorActionPreference = $old

        $text = $output | Out-String
        $last = $text

        if ($exit -eq 0) {
            if ($i -gt 1) {
                Log ("[PASS] " + $Label + " recuperado tentativa " + $i + "/12")
            }
            return $text
        }

        $transient = (
            $text -match 'fetch failed' -or
            $text -match 'connectivity issue' -or
            $text -match 'network connectivity' -or
            $text -match 'ETIMEDOUT' -or
            $text -match 'ECONNRESET' -or
            $text -match 'ENOTFOUND' -or
            $text -match 'EAI_AGAIN' -or
            $text -match '7403' -or
            $text -match '\b502\b' -or
            $text -match '\b503\b' -or
            $text -match '\b504\b'
        )

        if ($transient -and $i -lt 12) {
            Log ("[INFO] " + $Label + " transitorio " + $i + "/12")
            Start-Sleep -Seconds ([Math]::Min(2 * $i, 12))
            continue
        }

        throw ($Label + " falhou: " + $text)
    }

    throw ($Label + " retries esgotados: " + $last)
}

function Count-D1 {
    param([string]$Sql,[string]$Label)

    $text = Invoke-D1 -Sql $Sql -Label $Label
    $m = [regex]::Match($text,'"n"\s*:\s*(\d+)')

    if (-not $m.Success) {
        throw ("Contagem D1 nao parseavel em " + $Label + ": " + $text)
    }

    return [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
}

function Latest-R1-Pass {
    $dirs = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_\d{8}_\d{6}$' } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending

    foreach ($d in $dirs) {
        $r = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_RESULTADO.txt"
        $c = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"

        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $r) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)) {
            $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath $r -Raw

            if (
                $t -match 'GATE FALLBACK CARTOES ADJUDICADO PASS' -and
                $t -match 'P4\.6-W12-R1-MACRO CONCLUIDO - PASS'
            ) {
                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Dir = $d.FullName
                    Result = $r
                    Context = $c
                    Text = $t
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Context-Value {
    param([string]$Text,[string]$Key)

    $m = [regex]::Match(
        $Text,
        '(?m)^' + [regex]::Escape($Key) + '=(.*)$'
    )

    if ($m.Success) {
        return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
    }

    return $null
}

function Cleanup-E2E {
    param(
        [string]$Email,
        [string]$RecordId = ""
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Email)) { return }

    # Chamadas separadas: confiáveis no PowerShell 5.1/Wrangler.
    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup audit by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RecordId)) {
        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND record_id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup audit by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}

        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup record by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}
    }

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND updated_by=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup records by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_sessions WHERE user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup sessions" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_users WHERE email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}
}

function listFrom(service) {
  if (typeof service.list === 'function') return service.list();
  if (typeof service.listar === 'function') return service.listar();
  return [];
}

function findRecord(service, id) {
  if (!id) return null;

  if (typeof service.getById === 'function') {
    return service.getById(id);
  }

  if (typeof service.buscarPorId === 'function') {
    return service.buscarPorId(id);
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  return Array.isArray(list)
    ? list.find(item => String(item?.id) === String(id)) || null
    : null;
}

function nestedRecord(result) {
  if (!result || result.sucesso === false) return null;

  return (
    result.cartao ||
    result.item ||
    result.registro ||
    result.record ||
    (result.id ? result : null) ||
    null
  );
}

function recordFromResult(result, service, fallbackId = null, marker = null) {
  const nested = nestedRecord(result);
  if (nested?.id) return nested;

  if (fallbackId) {
    const byId = findRecord(service, fallbackId);
    if (byId?.id) return byId;
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  if (Array.isArray(list) && marker) {
    const byMarker = list.find(item =>
      item &&
      (
        item.nome === marker ||
        item.apelido === marker ||
        item.descricao === marker
      )
    );

    if (byMarker?.id) return byMarker;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
    const last = list[list.length - 1];
    if (last?.id) return last;
  }

  return null;
}

function explicitVersion(value) {
  const raw = value?._version ?? value?.version;
  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : null;
}

function responseVersion(response, fallback = null) {
  const raw =
    response?._version ??
    response?.version ??
    fallback;

  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0
    ? raw
    : null;
}

async function resolveVersion(id, preferred = null) {
  if (Number.isInteger(preferred) && preferred > 0) {
    return preferred;
  }

  const cached = versions.get(String(id));

  if (Number.isInteger(cached) && cached > 0) {
    return cached;
  }

  const current = await central.get(id);
  const version = responseVersion(current, current?._version);

  if (!version) {
    throw new Error('CENTRAL_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE');
  }

  versions.set(String(id), version);
  return version;
}

function fire(task, type, id = null) {
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(task)
    .then(result => {
      emit(type + ':ok', {
        id,
        version: responseVersion(result)
      });
    })
    .catch(error => {
      emit(type + ':error', {
        id,
        status: error?.status ?? null,
        message: String(error?.message || error)
      });
    });
}

function wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);
    const payload = args[0] || {};
    const marker =
      payload?.nome ??
      payload?.apelido ??
      payload?.descricao ??
      null;

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      payload?.id ?? null,
      marker
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const created = await central.create(record);
          const version = responseVersion(created, 1);

          if (version) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), version);
          }

          return created;
        },
        'create',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const payload =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || {});

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(payload);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      id ?? payload?.id ?? null,
      payload?.nome ?? payload?.apelido ?? payload?.descricao ?? null
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            record.id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const updated = await central.update(
            record.id,
            record,
            version
          );

          const nextVersion = responseVersion(
            updated,
            version + 1
          );

          if (nextVersion) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), nextVersion);
          }

          return updated;
        },
        'update',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const options =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || null);

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(options);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    if (id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const removed = await central.remove(
            id,
            version
          );

          versions.delete(String(id));
          return removed;
        },
        'remove',
        id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

export function withCartoesPilotCentralWrite(baseService) {
  if (!baseService || !central) return baseService;

  const wrapped = Object.create(baseService);

  for (const name of ['create','adicionar','criar','salvar']) {
    wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['update','editar','atualizar']) {
    wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['remove','remover','delete','excluir']) {
    wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  return wrapped;
}

export function getCartoesPilotVersion(id) {
  return versions.get(String(id)) ?? null;
}

export function clearCartoesPilotVersions() {
  versions.clear();
}

function Log {
    param([string]$Text)
    Write-Host $Text
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $Result -Value $Text -Encoding UTF8

function Need {
    param([bool]$Condition,[string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) { throw $Message }
}

function SqlQuote {
    param([string]$Value)
    return "'" + $Value.Replace("'","''") + "'"
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param([string]$Path,[string]$Content)
    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
    }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path,$Content,$enc)
}

function Copy-Tree {
    param([string]$Source,[string]$Destination)

    Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Source) ("Origem ausente: " + $Source)

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Destination) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Destination -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Destination -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Source -Force |
        ForEach-Object {
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $Destination -Recurse -Force
        }
}

function Invoke-D1 {
    param(
        [string]$Sql,
        [string]$Label = "D1"
    )

    $args = @(
        "--yes",
        "wrangler@latest",
        "d1",
        "execute",
        $StagingDb,
        "--remote",
        "--command",
        $Sql
    )

    $last = ""

    for ($i = 1; $i -le 12; $i++) {
        $old = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        $output = & $Npx @args 2>&1
        $exit = $LASTEXITCODE

        $ErrorActionPreference = $old

        $text = $output | Out-String
        $last = $text

        if ($exit -eq 0) {
            if ($i -gt 1) {
                Log ("[PASS] " + $Label + " recuperado tentativa " + $i + "/12")
            }
            return $text
        }

        $transient = (
            $text -match 'fetch failed' -or
            $text -match 'connectivity issue' -or
            $text -match 'network connectivity' -or
            $text -match 'ETIMEDOUT' -or
            $text -match 'ECONNRESET' -or
            $text -match 'ENOTFOUND' -or
            $text -match 'EAI_AGAIN' -or
            $text -match '7403' -or
            $text -match '\b502\b' -or
            $text -match '\b503\b' -or
            $text -match '\b504\b'
        )

        if ($transient -and $i -lt 12) {
            Log ("[INFO] " + $Label + " transitorio " + $i + "/12")
            Start-Sleep -Seconds ([Math]::Min(2 * $i, 12))
            continue
        }

        throw ($Label + " falhou: " + $text)
    }

    throw ($Label + " retries esgotados: " + $last)
}

function Count-D1 {
    param([string]$Sql,[string]$Label)

    $text = Invoke-D1 -Sql $Sql -Label $Label
    $m = [regex]::Match($text,'"n"\s*:\s*(\d+)')

    if (-not $m.Success) {
        throw ("Contagem D1 nao parseavel em " + $Label + ": " + $text)
    }

    return [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
}

function Latest-R1-Pass {
    $dirs = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_\d{8}_\d{6}$' } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending

    foreach ($d in $dirs) {
        $r = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_RESULTADO.txt"
        $c = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"

        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $r) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)) {
            $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath $r -Raw

            if (
                $t -match 'GATE FALLBACK CARTOES ADJUDICADO PASS' -and
                $t -match 'P4\.6-W12-R1-MACRO CONCLUIDO - PASS'
            ) {
                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Dir = $d.FullName
                    Result = $r
                    Context = $c
                    Text = $t
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Context-Value {
    param([string]$Text,[string]$Key)

    $m = [regex]::Match(
        $Text,
        '(?m)^' + [regex]::Escape($Key) + '=(.*)$'
    )

    if ($m.Success) {
        return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
    }

    return $null
}

function Cleanup-E2E {
    param(
        [string]$Email,
        [string]$RecordId = ""
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Email)) { return }

    # Chamadas separadas: confiáveis no PowerShell 5.1/Wrangler.
    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup audit by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RecordId)) {
        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND record_id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup audit by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}

        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup record by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}
    }

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND updated_by=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup records by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_sessions WHERE user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup sessions" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_users WHERE email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}
}

function listFrom(service) {
  if (typeof service.list === 'function') return service.list();
  if (typeof service.listar === 'function') return service.listar();
  return [];
}

function findRecord(service, id) {
  if (!id) return null;

  if (typeof service.getById === 'function') {
    return service.getById(id);
  }

  if (typeof service.buscarPorId === 'function') {
    return service.buscarPorId(id);
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  return Array.isArray(list)
    ? list.find(item => String(item?.id) === String(id)) || null
    : null;
}

function nestedRecord(result) {
  if (!result || result.sucesso === false) return null;

  return (
    result.cartao ||
    result.item ||
    result.registro ||
    result.record ||
    (result.id ? result : null) ||
    null
  );
}

function recordFromResult(result, service, fallbackId = null, marker = null) {
  const nested = nestedRecord(result);
  if (nested?.id) return nested;

  if (fallbackId) {
    const byId = findRecord(service, fallbackId);
    if (byId?.id) return byId;
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  if (Array.isArray(list) && marker) {
    const byMarker = list.find(item =>
      item &&
      (
        item.nome === marker ||
        item.apelido === marker ||
        item.descricao === marker ||
        item.banco === marker ||
        item.banco === marker
      )
    );

    if (byMarker?.id) return byMarker;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
    const last = list[list.length - 1];
    if (last?.id) return last;
  }

  return null;
}

function explicitVersion(value) {
  const raw = value?._version ?? value?.version;
  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : null;
}

function responseVersion(response, fallback = null) {
  const raw =
    response?._version ??
    response?.version ??
    fallback;

  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0
    ? raw
    : null;
}

async function resolveVersion(id, preferred = null) {
  if (Number.isInteger(preferred) && preferred > 0) {
    return preferred;
  }

  const cached = versions.get(String(id));

  if (Number.isInteger(cached) && cached > 0) {
    return cached;
  }

  const current = await central.get(id);
  const version = responseVersion(current, current?._version);

  if (!version) {
    throw new Error('CENTRAL_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE');
  }

  versions.set(String(id), version);
  return version;
}

function fire(task, type, id = null) {
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(task)
    .then(result => {
      emit(type + ':ok', {
        id,
        version: responseVersion(result)
      });
    })
    .catch(error => {
      emit(type + ':error', {
        id,
        status: error?.status ?? null,
        message: String(error?.message || error)
      });
    });
}

function wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);
    const payload = args[0] || {};
    const marker =
      payload?.nome ??
      payload?.apelido ??
      payload?.descricao ??
      payload?.banco ??
      null;

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      payload?.id ?? null,
      marker
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const created = await central.create(record);
          const version = responseVersion(created, 1);

          if (version) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), version);
          }

          return created;
        },
        'create',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const payload =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || {});

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(payload);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      id ?? payload?.id ?? null,
      payload?.nome ?? payload?.apelido ?? payload?.descricao ?? payload?.banco ?? null
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            record.id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const updated = await central.update(
            record.id,
            record,
            version
          );

          const nextVersion = responseVersion(
            updated,
            version + 1
          );

          if (nextVersion) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), nextVersion);
          }

          return updated;
        },
        'update',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const options =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || null);

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(options);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    if (id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const removed = await central.remove(
            id,
            version
          );

          versions.delete(String(id));
          return removed;
        },
        'remove',
        id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

export function withCartoesPilotCentralWrite(baseService) {
  if (!baseService || !central) return baseService;

  const wrapped = Object.create(baseService);

  for (const name of ['create','adicionar','criar','salvar']) {
    wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['update','editar','atualizar']) {
    wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['remove','remover','delete','excluir']) {
    wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  return wrapped;
}

export function getCartoesPilotVersion(id) {
  return versions.get(String(id)) ?? null;
}

export function clearCartoesPilotVersions() {
  versions.clear();
}

function Log {
    param([string]$Text)
    Write-Host $Text
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $Result -Value $Text -Encoding UTF8
}

function Need {
    param([bool]$Condition,[string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) { throw $Message }
}

function SqlQuote {
    param([string]$Value)
    return "'" + $Value.Replace("'","''") + "'"
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param([string]$Path,[string]$Content)
    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
    }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path,$Content,$enc)
}

function Copy-Tree {
    param([string]$Source,[string]$Destination)

    Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Source) ("Origem ausente: " + $Source)

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Destination) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Destination -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Destination -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Source -Force |
        ForEach-Object {
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $Destination -Recurse -Force
        }
}

function Invoke-D1 {
    param(
        [string]$Sql,
        [string]$Label = "D1"
    )

    $args = @(
        "--yes",
        "wrangler@latest",
        "d1",
        "execute",
        $StagingDb,
        "--remote",
        "--command",
        $Sql
    )

    $last = ""

    for ($i = 1; $i -le 12; $i++) {
        $old = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        $output = & $Npx @args 2>&1
        $exit = $LASTEXITCODE

        $ErrorActionPreference = $old

        $text = $output | Out-String
        $last = $text

        if ($exit -eq 0) {
            if ($i -gt 1) {
                Log ("[PASS] " + $Label + " recuperado tentativa " + $i + "/12")
            }
            return $text
        }

        $transient = (
            $text -match 'fetch failed' -or
            $text -match 'connectivity issue' -or
            $text -match 'network connectivity' -or
            $text -match 'ETIMEDOUT' -or
            $text -match 'ECONNRESET' -or
            $text -match 'ENOTFOUND' -or
            $text -match 'EAI_AGAIN' -or
            $text -match '7403' -or
            $text -match '\b502\b' -or
            $text -match '\b503\b' -or
            $text -match '\b504\b'
        )

        if ($transient -and $i -lt 12) {
            Log ("[INFO] " + $Label + " transitorio " + $i + "/12")
            Start-Sleep -Seconds ([Math]::Min(2 * $i, 12))
            continue
        }

        throw ($Label + " falhou: " + $text)
    }

    throw ($Label + " retries esgotados: " + $last)
}

function Count-D1 {
    param([string]$Sql,[string]$Label)

    $text = Invoke-D1 -Sql $Sql -Label $Label
    $m = [regex]::Match($text,'"n"\s*:\s*(\d+)')

    if (-not $m.Success) {
        throw ("Contagem D1 nao parseavel em " + $Label + ": " + $text)
    }

    return [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
}

function Latest-R1-Pass {
    $dirs = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_\d{8}_\d{6}$' } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending

    foreach ($d in $dirs) {
        $r = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_RESULTADO.txt"
        $c = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"

        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $r) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)) {
            $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath $r -Raw

            if (
                $t -match 'GATE FALLBACK CARTOES ADJUDICADO PASS' -and
                $t -match 'P4\.6-W12-R1-MACRO CONCLUIDO - PASS'
            ) {
                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Dir = $d.FullName
                    Result = $r
                    Context = $c
                    Text = $t
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Context-Value {
    param([string]$Text,[string]$Key)

    $m = [regex]::Match(
        $Text,
        '(?m)^' + [regex]::Escape($Key) + '=(.*)$'
    )

    if ($m.Success) {
        return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
    }

    return $null
}

function Cleanup-E2E {
    param(
        [string]$Email,
        [string]$RecordId = ""
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Email)) { return }

    # Chamadas separadas: confiáveis no PowerShell 5.1/Wrangler.
    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup audit by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RecordId)) {
        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND record_id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup audit by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}

        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup record by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}
    }

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND updated_by=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup records by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_sessions WHERE user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup sessions" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_users WHERE email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}
}
