function listFrom(service) {
  if (typeof service.list === 'function') return service.list();
  if (typeof service.listar === 'function') return service.listar();
  return [];
}

function findRecord(service, id) {
  if (!id) return null;

  if (typeof service.getById === 'function') {
    return service.getById(id);
  }

  if (typeof service.buscarPorId === 'function') {
    return service.buscarPorId(id);
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  return Array.isArray(list)
    ? list.find(item => String(item?.id) === String(id)) || null
    : null;
}

function nestedRecord(result) {
  if (!result || result.sucesso === false) return null;

  return (
    result.cartao ||
    result.item ||
    result.registro ||
    result.record ||
    (result.id ? result : null) ||
    null
  );
}

function recordFromResult(result, service, fallbackId = null, marker = null) {
  const nested = nestedRecord(result);
  if (nested?.id) return nested;

  if (fallbackId) {
    const byId = findRecord(service, fallbackId);
    if (byId?.id) return byId;
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  if (Array.isArray(list) && marker) {
    const byMarker = list.find(item =>
      item &&
      (
        item.nome === marker ||
        item.apelido === marker ||
        item.descricao === marker ||
        item.banco === marker ||
        item.banco === marker
      )
    );

    if (byMarker?.id) return byMarker;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
    const last = list[list.length - 1];
    if (last?.id) return last;
  }

  return null;
}

function explicitVersion(value) {
  const raw = value?._version ?? value?.version;
  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : null;
}

function responseVersion(response, fallback = null) {
  const raw =
    response?._version ??
    response?.version ??
    fallback;

  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0
    ? raw
    : null;
}

async function resolveVersion(id, preferred = null) {
  if (Number.isInteger(preferred) && preferred > 0) {
    return preferred;
  }

  const cached = versions.get(String(id));

  if (Number.isInteger(cached) && cached > 0) {
    return cached;
  }

  const current = await central.get(id);
  const version = responseVersion(current, current?._version);

  if (!version) {
    throw new Error('CENTRAL_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE');
  }

  versions.set(String(id), version);
  return version;
}

function fire(task, type, id = null) {
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(task)
    .then(result => {
      emit(type + ':ok', {
        id,
        version: responseVersion(result)
      });
    })
    .catch(error => {
      emit(type + ':error', {
        id,
        status: error?.status ?? null,
        message: String(error?.message || error)
      });
    });
}

function wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    // Cartoes usa editar(id, payload). O harness generico pode chamar update(payload).
    // Normalize apenas no bridge E2E; o service original permanece intacto.
    const callArgs =
      method === 'editar' && typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? [id, payload]
        : args;

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, callArgs);
    const payload = args[0] || {};
    const marker =
      payload?.nome ??
      payload?.apelido ??
      payload?.descricao ??
      payload?.banco ??
      null;

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      payload?.id ?? null,
      marker
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const created = await central.create(record);
          const version = responseVersion(created, 1);

          if (version) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), version);
          }

          return created;
        },
        'create',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const payload =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || {});

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(payload);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      id ?? payload?.id ?? null,
      payload?.nome ?? payload?.apelido ?? payload?.descricao ?? payload?.banco ?? null
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            record.id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const updated = await central.update(
            record.id,
            record,
            version
          );

          const nextVersion = responseVersion(
            updated,
            version + 1
          );

          if (nextVersion) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), nextVersion);
          }

          return updated;
        },
        'update',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const options =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || null);

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(options);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    if (id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const removed = await central.remove(
            id,
            version
          );

          versions.delete(String(id));
          return removed;
        },
        'remove',
        id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

export function withCartoesPilotCentralWrite(baseService) {
  if (!baseService || !central) return baseService;

  const wrapped = Object.create(baseService);

  for (const name of ['create','adicionar','criar','salvar']) {
    wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['update','editar','atualizar']) {
    wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['remove','remover','delete','excluir']) {
    wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  return wrapped;
}

export function getCartoesPilotVersion(id) {
  return versions.get(String(id)) ?? null;
}

export function clearCartoesPilotVersions() {
  versions.clear();
}

function Log {
    param([string]$Text)
    Write-Host $Text
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $Result -Value $Text -Encoding UTF8
}

function Need {
    param([bool]$Condition,[string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) { throw $Message }
}

function SqlQuote {
    param([string]$Value)
    return "'" + $Value.Replace("'","''") + "'"
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param([string]$Path,[string]$Content)
    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
    }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path,$Content,$enc)
}

function Copy-Tree {
    param([string]$Source,[string]$Destination)

    Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Source) ("Origem ausente: " + $Source)

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Destination) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Destination -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Destination -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Source -Force |
        ForEach-Object {
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $Destination -Recurse -Force
        }
}

function Invoke-D1 {
    param(
        [string]$Sql,
        [string]$Label = "D1"
    )

    $args = @(
        "--yes",
        "wrangler@latest",
        "d1",
        "execute",
        $StagingDb,
        "--remote",
        "--command",
        $Sql
    )

    $last = ""

    for ($i = 1; $i -le 12; $i++) {
        $old = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        $output = & $Npx @args 2>&1
        $exit = $LASTEXITCODE

        $ErrorActionPreference = $old

        $text = $output | Out-String
        $last = $text

        if ($exit -eq 0) {
            if ($i -gt 1) {
                Log ("[PASS] " + $Label + " recuperado tentativa " + $i + "/12")
            }
            return $text
        }

        $transient = (
            $text -match 'fetch failed' -or
            $text -match 'connectivity issue' -or
            $text -match 'network connectivity' -or
            $text -match 'ETIMEDOUT' -or
            $text -match 'ECONNRESET' -or
            $text -match 'ENOTFOUND' -or
            $text -match 'EAI_AGAIN' -or
            $text -match '7403' -or
            $text -match '\b502\b' -or
            $text -match '\b503\b' -or
            $text -match '\b504\b'
        )

        if ($transient -and $i -lt 12) {
            Log ("[INFO] " + $Label + " transitorio " + $i + "/12")
            Start-Sleep -Seconds ([Math]::Min(2 * $i, 12))
            continue
        }

        throw ($Label + " falhou: " + $text)
    }

    throw ($Label + " retries esgotados: " + $last)
}

function Count-D1 {
    param([string]$Sql,[string]$Label)

    $text = Invoke-D1 -Sql $Sql -Label $Label
    $m = [regex]::Match($text,'"n"\s*:\s*(\d+)')

    if (-not $m.Success) {
        throw ("Contagem D1 nao parseavel em " + $Label + ": " + $text)
    }

    return [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
}

function Latest-R1-Pass {
    $dirs = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_\d{8}_\d{6}$' } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending

    foreach ($d in $dirs) {
        $r = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_RESULTADO.txt"
        $c = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"

        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $r) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)) {
            $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath $r -Raw

            if (
                $t -match 'GATE FALLBACK CARTOES ADJUDICADO PASS' -and
                $t -match 'P4\.6-W12-R1-MACRO CONCLUIDO - PASS'
            ) {
                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Dir = $d.FullName
                    Result = $r
                    Context = $c
                    Text = $t
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Context-Value {
    param([string]$Text,[string]$Key)

    $m = [regex]::Match(
        $Text,
        '(?m)^' + [regex]::Escape($Key) + '=(.*)$'
    )

    if ($m.Success) {
        return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
    }

    return $null
}

function Cleanup-E2E {
    param(
        [string]$Email,
        [string]$RecordId = ""
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Email)) { return }

    # Chamadas separadas: confiáveis no PowerShell 5.1/Wrangler.
    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup audit by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RecordId)) {
        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND record_id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup audit by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}

        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup record by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}
    }

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND updated_by=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup records by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_sessions WHERE user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup sessions" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_users WHERE email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}
}

function emit(type, detail = {}) {

function listFrom(service) {
  if (typeof service.list === 'function') return service.list();
  if (typeof service.listar === 'function') return service.listar();
  return [];
}

function findRecord(service, id) {
  if (!id) return null;

  if (typeof service.getById === 'function') {
    return service.getById(id);
  }

  if (typeof service.buscarPorId === 'function') {
    return service.buscarPorId(id);
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  return Array.isArray(list)
    ? list.find(item => String(item?.id) === String(id)) || null
    : null;
}

function nestedRecord(result) {
  if (!result || result.sucesso === false) return null;

  return (
    result.cartao ||
    result.item ||
    result.registro ||
    result.record ||
    (result.id ? result : null) ||
    null
  );
}

function recordFromResult(result, service, fallbackId = null, marker = null) {
  const nested = nestedRecord(result);
  if (nested?.id) return nested;

  if (fallbackId) {
    const byId = findRecord(service, fallbackId);
    if (byId?.id) return byId;
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  if (Array.isArray(list) && marker) {
    const byMarker = list.find(item =>
      item &&
      (
        item.nome === marker ||
        item.apelido === marker ||
        item.descricao === marker ||
        item.banco === marker ||
        item.banco === marker
      )
    );

    if (byMarker?.id) return byMarker;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
    const last = list[list.length - 1];
    if (last?.id) return last;
  }

  return null;
}

function explicitVersion(value) {
  const raw = value?._version ?? value?.version;
  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : null;
}

function responseVersion(response, fallback = null) {
  const raw =
    response?._version ??
    response?.version ??
    fallback;

  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0
    ? raw
    : null;
}

async function resolveVersion(id, preferred = null) {
  if (Number.isInteger(preferred) && preferred > 0) {
    return preferred;
  }

  const cached = versions.get(String(id));

  if (Number.isInteger(cached) && cached > 0) {
    return cached;
  }

  const current = await central.get(id);
  const version = responseVersion(current, current?._version);

  if (!version) {
    throw new Error('CENTRAL_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE');
  }

  versions.set(String(id), version);
  return version;
}

function fire(task, type, id = null) {
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(task)
    .then(result => {
      emit(type + ':ok', {
        id,
        version: responseVersion(result)
      });
    })
    .catch(error => {
      emit(type + ':error', {
        id,
        status: error?.status ?? null,
        message: String(error?.message || error)
      });
    });
}

function wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);
    const payload = args[0] || {};
    const marker =
      payload?.nome ??
      payload?.apelido ??
      payload?.descricao ??
      payload?.banco ??
      null;

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      payload?.id ?? null,
      marker
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const created = await central.create(record);
          const version = responseVersion(created, 1);

          if (version) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), version);
          }

          return created;
        },
        'create',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const payload =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || {});

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(payload);

    // O wrapper usa (...args), portanto wrapped.editar.length === 0.
    // O harness chama editar({id,...payload}), mas o service real exige editar(id,payload).
    // Normalizamos SOMENTE no bridge E2E.
    const localArgs =
      method === 'editar' && typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? [id, payload]
        : args;

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, localArgs);

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      id ?? payload?.id ?? null,
      payload?.nome ?? payload?.apelido ?? payload?.descricao ?? payload?.banco ?? null
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            record.id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const updated = await central.update(
            record.id,
            record,
            version
          );

          const nextVersion = responseVersion(
            updated,
            version + 1
          );

          if (nextVersion) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), nextVersion);
          }

          return updated;
        },
        'update',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const options =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || null);

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(options);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    if (id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const removed = await central.remove(
            id,
            version
          );

          versions.delete(String(id));
          return removed;
        },
        'remove',
        id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

export function withCartoesPilotCentralWrite(baseService) {
  if (!baseService || !central) return baseService;

  const wrapped = Object.create(baseService);

  for (const name of ['create','adicionar','criar','salvar']) {
    wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['update','editar','atualizar']) {
    wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['remove','remover','delete','excluir']) {
    wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  return wrapped;
}

export function getCartoesPilotVersion(id) {
  return versions.get(String(id)) ?? null;
}

export function clearCartoesPilotVersions() {
  versions.clear();
}

function Log {
    param([string]$Text)
    Write-Host $Text
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $Result -Value $Text -Encoding UTF8
}

function Need {
    param([bool]$Condition,[string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) { throw $Message }
}

function SqlQuote {
    param([string]$Value)
    return "'" + $Value.Replace("'","''") + "'"
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param([string]$Path,[string]$Content)
    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
    }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path,$Content,$enc)
}

function Copy-Tree {
    param([string]$Source,[string]$Destination)

    Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Source) ("Origem ausente: " + $Source)

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Destination) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Destination -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Destination -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Source -Force |
        ForEach-Object {
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $Destination -Recurse -Force
        }
}

function Invoke-D1 {
    param(
        [string]$Sql,
        [string]$Label = "D1"
    )

    $args = @(
        "--yes",
        "wrangler@latest",
        "d1",
        "execute",
        $StagingDb,
        "--remote",
        "--command",
        $Sql
    )

    $last = ""

    for ($i = 1; $i -le 12; $i++) {
        $old = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        $output = & $Npx @args 2>&1
        $exit = $LASTEXITCODE

        $ErrorActionPreference = $old

        $text = $output | Out-String
        $last = $text

        if ($exit -eq 0) {
            if ($i -gt 1) {
                Log ("[PASS] " + $Label + " recuperado tentativa " + $i + "/12")
            }
            return $text
        }

        $transient = (
            $text -match 'fetch failed' -or
            $text -match 'connectivity issue' -or
            $text -match 'network connectivity' -or
            $text -match 'ETIMEDOUT' -or
            $text -match 'ECONNRESET' -or
            $text -match 'ENOTFOUND' -or
            $text -match 'EAI_AGAIN' -or
            $text -match '7403' -or
            $text -match '\b502\b' -or
            $text -match '\b503\b' -or
            $text -match '\b504\b'
        )

        if ($transient -and $i -lt 12) {
            Log ("[INFO] " + $Label + " transitorio " + $i + "/12")
            Start-Sleep -Seconds ([Math]::Min(2 * $i, 12))
            continue
        }

        throw ($Label + " falhou: " + $text)
    }

    throw ($Label + " retries esgotados: " + $last)
}

function Count-D1 {
    param([string]$Sql,[string]$Label)

    $text = Invoke-D1 -Sql $Sql -Label $Label
    $m = [regex]::Match($text,'"n"\s*:\s*(\d+)')

    if (-not $m.Success) {
        throw ("Contagem D1 nao parseavel em " + $Label + ": " + $text)
    }

    return [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
}

function Latest-R1-Pass {
    $dirs = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_\d{8}_\d{6}$' } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending

    foreach ($d in $dirs) {
        $r = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_RESULTADO.txt"
        $c = Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W12_R1_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"

        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $r) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)) {
            $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath $r -Raw

            if (
                $t -match 'GATE FALLBACK CARTOES ADJUDICADO PASS' -and
                $t -match 'P4\.6-W12-R1-MACRO CONCLUIDO - PASS'
            ) {
                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Dir = $d.FullName
                    Result = $r
                    Context = $c
                    Text = $t
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Context-Value {
    param([string]$Text,[string]$Key)

    $m = [regex]::Match(
        $Text,
        '(?m)^' + [regex]::Escape($Key) + '=(.*)$'
    )

    if ($m.Success) {
        return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
    }

    return $null
}

function Cleanup-E2E {
    param(
        [string]$Email,
        [string]$RecordId = ""
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Email)) { return }

    # Chamadas separadas: confiáveis no PowerShell 5.1/Wrangler.
    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup audit by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RecordId)) {
        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE entity='cartoes' AND record_id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup audit by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}

        try {
            Invoke-D1 `
                -Sql (
                    "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND id=" +
                    (SqlQuote $RecordId) + ";"
                ) `
                -Label "cleanup record by id" |
                Out-Null
        } catch {}
    }

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM records WHERE entity='cartoes' AND updated_by=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup records by user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_sessions WHERE user_email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup sessions" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}

    try {
        Invoke-D1 `
            -Sql (
                "DELETE FROM auth_users WHERE email=" +
                (SqlQuote $Email) + ";"
            ) `
            -Label "cleanup user" |
            Out-Null
    } catch {}
}

function listFrom(service) {
  if (typeof service.list === 'function') return service.list();
  if (typeof service.listar === 'function') return service.listar();
  return [];
}

function findRecord(service, id) {
  if (!id) return null;

  if (typeof service.getById === 'function') {
    return service.getById(id);
  }

  if (typeof service.buscarPorId === 'function') {
    return service.buscarPorId(id);
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  return Array.isArray(list)
    ? list.find(item => String(item?.id) === String(id)) || null
    : null;
}

function nestedRecord(result) {
  if (!result || result.sucesso === false) return null;

  return (
    result.cartao ||
    result.item ||
    result.registro ||
    result.record ||
    (result.id ? result : null) ||
    null
  );
}

function recordFromResult(result, service, fallbackId = null, marker = null) {
  const nested = nestedRecord(result);
  if (nested?.id) return nested;

  if (fallbackId) {
    const byId = findRecord(service, fallbackId);
    if (byId?.id) return byId;
  }

  const list = listFrom(service);

  if (Array.isArray(list) && marker) {
    const byMarker = list.find(item =>
      item &&
      (
        item.nome === marker ||
        item.apelido === marker ||
        item.descricao === marker
      )
    );

    if (byMarker?.id) return byMarker;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
    const last = list[list.length - 1];
    if (last?.id) return last;
  }

  return null;
}

function explicitVersion(value) {
  const raw = value?._version ?? value?.version;
  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : null;
}

function responseVersion(response, fallback = null) {
  const raw =
    response?._version ??
    response?.version ??
    fallback;

  return Number.isInteger(raw) && raw > 0
    ? raw
    : null;
}

async function resolveVersion(id, preferred = null) {
  if (Number.isInteger(preferred) && preferred > 0) {
    return preferred;
  }

  const cached = versions.get(String(id));

  if (Number.isInteger(cached) && cached > 0) {
    return cached;
  }

  const current = await central.get(id);
  const version = responseVersion(current, current?._version);

  if (!version) {
    throw new Error('CENTRAL_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE');
  }

  versions.set(String(id), version);
  return version;
}

function fire(task, type, id = null) {
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(task)
    .then(result => {
      emit(type + ':ok', {
        id,
        version: responseVersion(result)
      });
    })
    .catch(error => {
      emit(type + ':error', {
        id,
        status: error?.status ?? null,
        message: String(error?.message || error)
      });
    });
}

function wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);
    const payload = args[0] || {};
    const marker =
      payload?.nome ??
      payload?.apelido ??
      payload?.descricao ??
      null;

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      payload?.id ?? null,
      marker
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const created = await central.create(record);
          const version = responseVersion(created, 1);

          if (version) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), version);
          }

          return created;
        },
        'create',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const payload =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || {});

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(payload);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    const record = recordFromResult(
      result,
      baseService,
      id ?? payload?.id ?? null,
      payload?.nome ?? payload?.apelido ?? payload?.descricao ?? null
    );

    if (record?.id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            record.id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const updated = await central.update(
            record.id,
            record,
            version
          );

          const nextVersion = responseVersion(
            updated,
            version + 1
          );

          if (nextVersion) {
            versions.set(String(record.id), nextVersion);
          }

          return updated;
        },
        'update',
        record.id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

function wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, method) {
  if (typeof baseService[method] !== 'function') return;

  wrapped[method] = function(...args) {
    const id =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]?.id
        : args[0];

    const options =
      typeof args[0] === 'object'
        ? args[0]
        : (args[1] || null);

    const requestedVersion = explicitVersion(options);

    const result = baseService[method].apply(baseService, args);

    if (id && result?.sucesso !== false) {
      fire(
        async () => {
          const version = await resolveVersion(
            id,
            requestedVersion
          );

          const removed = await central.remove(
            id,
            version
          );

          versions.delete(String(id));
          return removed;
        },
        'remove',
        id
      );
    }

    return result;
  };
}

export function withCartoesPilotCentralWrite(baseService) {
  if (!baseService || !central) return baseService;

  const wrapped = Object.create(baseService);

  for (const name of ['create','adicionar','criar','salvar']) {
    wrapCreate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['update','editar','atualizar']) {
    wrapUpdate(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  for (const name of ['remove','remover','delete','excluir']) {
    wrapDelete(wrapped, baseService, name);
  }

  return wrapped;
}

export function getCartoesPilotVersion(id) {
  return versions.get(String(id)) ?? null;
}

export function clearCartoesPilotVersions() {
  versions.clear();
}

function L([string]$s){ $Log.Add($s); Write-Host $s }

  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($p,$s,$enc)

function Latest-W13Pass {
  $dirs=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
    Where-Object {$_.Name -match '^P4_6_W13_R2_MACRO_\d{8}_\d{6}$'} |
    Sort-Object Name -Descending
  foreach($d in $dirs){
    $r=Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W13_R2_MACRO_RESULTADO.txt"
    $c=Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W13_R2_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"
    if((Test-Path -LiteralPath $r) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)){
      $t=Get-Content -LiteralPath $r -Raw
      if($t -match 'CARTOES CONSOLIDADO \+ PROXIMA ENTIDADE RANQUEADA PASS' -and
         $t -match 'PROXIMA ENTIDADE:\s*compras' -and
         $t -match 'CENTRAL WRITE GLOBAL:\s*false'){
        return [pscustomobject]@{Dir=$d.FullName;Result=$r;Context=$c;Text=$t}
      }
    }
  }
  return $null
}
function Ctx([string]$text,[string]$key){
  $m=[regex]::Match($text,'(?m)^'+[regex]::Escape($key)+'=(.*)$')
  if($m.Success){return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()}
  return $null
}
function First-Method([string]$text,[string[]]$names){
  foreach($n in $names){
    if($text -match ('(?m)^\s*(?:async\s+)?'+[regex]::Escape($n)+'\s*\(')){ return $n }
    if($text -match ('\b'+[regex]::Escape($n)+'\s*:\s*(?:async\s*)?\(')){ return $n }
    if($text -match ('\b'+[regex]::Escape($n)+'\s*:\s*(?:async\s*)?function\b')){ return $n }
  }
  return $null
}

         $t -match 'PROXIMA ENTIDADE:\s*compras' -and
         $t -match 'CENTRAL WRITE GLOBAL:\s*false'){
        return [pscustomobject]@{Dir=$d.FullName;Result=$r;Context=$c;Text=$t}
      }
    }
  }
  return $null
}
function Ctx([string]$text,[string]$key){
  $m=[regex]::Match($text,'(?m)^'+[regex]::Escape($key)+'=(.*)$')
  if($m.Success){return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()}
  return $null
}
function First-Method([string]$text,[string[]]$names){
  foreach($n in $names){
    $e=[regex]::Escape($n)
    # method shorthand: adicionar(...) / async adicionar(...)
    if($text -match ('(?m)^\s*(?:async\s+)?'+$e+'\s*\(')){ return $n }
    # object property arrow/function: adicionar: (...) => / adicionar: function(...)
    if($text -match ('\b'+$e+'\s*:\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:function\b|\([^)]*\)\s*=>|[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*=>)')){ return $n }
    # declarations: function adicionar(...) / const adicionar = (...) =>
    if($text -match ('(?m)\bfunction\s+'+$e+'\s*\(')){ return $n }
    if($text -match ('(?m)\b(?:const|let|var)\s+'+$e+'\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:function\b|\([^)]*\)\s*=>|[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*=>)')){ return $n }
    # exposed alias: adicionar: createCompra / adicionar,
    if($text -match ('(?m)(?:\{|,)\s*'+$e+'\s*(?=,|\})')){ return $n }
    if($text -match ('(?m)\b'+$e+'\s*:\s*[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*(?=,|\})')){ return $n }
  }
  return $null
}
function Discover-By-Semantics([string]$text,[string]$kind){
  $patterns = switch($kind){
    "create" { @('(?i)\b(add|adicion|cri|cadastr|insert|novo|salv)\w*\b') }
    "read"   { @('(?i)\b(list|listar|buscar|obter|get|todos|consult)\w*\b') }
    "update" { @('(?i)\b(edit|atualiz|update|alter|salv)\w*\b') }
    "delete" { @('(?i)\b(exclu|remov|delete|apag)\w*\b') }
  }
  $ids=[regex]::Matches($text,'\b[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*\b') | ForEach-Object {$_.Value} | Select-Object -Unique
  foreach($id in $ids){
    foreach($p in $patterns){
      if($id -match $p){
        $e=[regex]::Escape($id)
        if($text -match ('(?m)(?:function\s+'+$e+'\s*\(|(?:const|let|var)\s+'+$e+'\s*=|(?:\{|,)\s*'+$e+'\s*(?=:|,|\})|^\s*(?:async\s+)?'+$e+'\s*\()')){
          return $id
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return $null
}

    # declarations: function adicionar(...) / const adicionar = (...) =>
    if($text -match ('(?m)\bfunction\s+'+$e+'\s*\(')){ return $n }
    if($text -match ('(?m)\b(?:const|let|var)\s+'+$e+'\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:function\b|\([^)]*\)\s*=>|[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*=>)')){ return $n }

$Log = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
function L([string]$s){ $Log.Add($s); Write-Host $s }
function Need([bool]$ok,[string]$msg){ if(-not $ok){ throw $msg } }
function U8([string]$p,[string]$s){
  $enc=New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($true)
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($p,$s,$enc)
}
function Latest-W13Pass {
  $dirs=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
    Where-Object {$_.Name -match '^P4_6_W13_R2_MACRO_\d{8}_\d{6}$'} |
    Sort-Object Name -Descending
  foreach($d in $dirs){
    $r=Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W13_R2_MACRO_RESULTADO.txt"
    $c=Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W13_R2_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"
    if((Test-Path -LiteralPath $r) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)){
      $t=Get-Content -LiteralPath $r -Raw
      if($t -match 'CARTOES CONSOLIDADO \+ PROXIMA ENTIDADE RANQUEADA PASS' -and
         $t -match 'PROXIMA ENTIDADE:\s*compras' -and
         $t -match 'CENTRAL WRITE GLOBAL:\s*false'){
        return [pscustomobject]@{Dir=$d.FullName;Result=$r;Context=$c;Text=$t}
      }
    }
  }
  return $null
}
function Ctx([string]$text,[string]$key){
  $m=[regex]::Match($text,'(?m)^'+[regex]::Escape($key)+'=(.*)$')
  if($m.Success){return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()}
  return $null
}
function First-Method([string]$text,[string[]]$names){
  foreach($n in $names){
    $e=[regex]::Escape($n)
    # method shorthand: adicionar(...) / async adicionar(...)
    if($text -match ('(?m)^\s*(?:async\s+)?'+$e+'\s*\(')){ return $n }
    # object property arrow/function: adicionar: (...) => / adicionar: function(...)
    if($text -match ('\b'+$e+'\s*:\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:function\b|\([^)]*\)\s*=>|[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*=>)')){ return $n }
    # declarations: function adicionar(...) / const adicionar = (...) =>
    if($text -match ('(?m)\bfunction\s+'+$e+'\s*\(')){ return $n }
    if($text -match ('(?m)\b(?:const|let|var)\s+'+$e+'\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:function\b|\([^)]*\)\s*=>|[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*=>)')){ return $n }
    # exposed alias: adicionar: createCompra / adicionar,
    if($text -match ('(?m)(?:\{|,)\s*'+$e+'\s*(?=,|\})')){ return $n }
    if($text -match ('(?m)\b'+$e+'\s*:\s*[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*(?=,|\})')){ return $n }
  }
  return $null
}
function Discover-By-Semantics([string]$text,[string]$kind){
  $patterns = switch($kind){
    "create" { @('(?i)\b(add|adicion|cri|cadastr|insert|novo|salv)\w*\b') }
    "read"   { @('(?i)\b(list|listar|buscar|obter|get|todos|consult)\w*\b') }
    "update" { @('(?i)\b(edit|atualiz|update|alter|salv)\w*\b') }
    "delete" { @('(?i)\b(exclu|remov|delete|apag)\w*\b') }
  }
  $ids=[regex]::Matches($text,'\b[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*\b') | ForEach-Object {$_.Value} | Select-Object -Unique
  foreach($id in $ids){
    foreach($p in $patterns){
      if($id -match $p){
        $e=[regex]::Escape($id)
        if($text -match ('(?m)(?:function\s+'+$e+'\s*\(|(?:const|let|var)\s+'+$e+'\s*=|(?:\{|,)\s*'+$e+'\s*(?=:|,|\})|^\s*(?:async\s+)?'+$e+'\s*\()')){
          return $id
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return $null
}

$Log = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
function L([string]$s){ $Log.Add($s); Write-Host $s }
function Need([bool]$ok,[string]$msg){ if(-not $ok){ throw $msg } }
function U8([string]$p,[string]$s){
  $enc=New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($true)
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($p,$s,$enc)
}
function Latest-W14Pass {
  $dirs=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $AuditRoot -Directory |
    Where-Object {$_.Name -match '^P4_6_W14_R2_MACRO_\d{8}_\d{6}$'} |
    Sort-Object Name -Descending
  foreach($d in $dirs){
    $r=Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W14_R2_MACRO_RESULTADO.txt"
    $c=Join-Path $d.FullName "P4_6_W14_R2_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"
    if((Test-Path -LiteralPath $r) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)){
      $t=Get-Content -LiteralPath $r -Raw
      if($t -match 'COMPRAS INSTRUMENTADO \+ PREFLIGHT E2E PASS' -and
         $t -match 'GO PARA E2E REAL COMPRAS EM STAGING'){
        return [pscustomobject]@{Dir=$d.FullName;Result=$r;Context=$c;Text=$t}
      }
    }
  }
  return $null
}
function Ctx([string]$text,[string]$key){
  $m=[regex]::Match($text,'(?m)^'+[regex]::Escape($key)+'=(.*)$')
  if($m.Success){ return $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim() }
  return $null
}

$ctx=Get-Content -LiteralPath $w14.Context -Raw
$candidate=Ctx $ctx "CANDIDATE"
if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($candidate)){
  $m=[regex]::Match($w14.Text,'(?m)^CANDIDATO:\s*(.+)$')
  if($m.Success){$candidate=$m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()}
}
Need (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($candidate)) "candidate ausente"
Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate) "candidate W14-R2 nao existe"

L "===== 3/9 INSPECIONAR SERVICE REAL SEM ALTERAR ====="
$service=Join-Path $candidate "public\services\comprasService.js"
Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $service) "comprasService.js ausente"
$lines=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath $service)
$st=$lines -join "`n"
Need ($st -match 'createComprasService') "factory Compras ausente"
Need ($st -match '\bcreate\b') "CREATE real ausente"
Need ($st -match '\blist\b') "READ real ausente"
Need ($st -match '\bupdate\b') "UPDATE real ausente"
Need ($st -match '\bremove\b') "DELETE real ausente"
L "[PASS] create/list/update/remove reais"

L ""
L "===== 4/9 EXTRAIR CONTRATO DE PAYLOAD AUTOMATICAMENTE ====="
$interesting=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$keys=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]
for($i=0;$i -lt $lines.Count;$i++){
  $line=$lines[$i]
  if($line -match '(?i)obrigat|required|valid|erro|create\s*\(|update\s*\(|fornecedor|data|valor|total|item|produto|insumo|quantidade|preco|preço|pagamento|nota|documento|id\b'){
    $interesting.Add(("{0,5}: {1}" -f ($i+1),$line))
  }
  foreach($m in [regex]::Matches($line,'(?:dados|compra|payload|input|item|obj)\??\.([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)')){
    [void]$keys.Add($m.Groups[1].Value)
  }
  foreach($m in [regex]::Matches($line,'\b([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*:\s*(?:dados|compra|payload|input)\??\.')){
    [void]$keys.Add($m.Groups[1].Value)
  }
}
Need ($interesting.Count -gt 0) "nao foi possivel extrair contexto de payload"
$contractText=@(
  "P4.6-W15 - CONTRATO REAL COMPRAS"
  "SERVICE=$service"
  "CREATE_METHOD=create"
  "READ_METHOD=list"
  "UPDATE_METHOD=update"
  "DELETE_METHOD=remove"
  "FIELDS_DISCOVERED="+(($keys | Sort-Object) -join ",")
  ""
  "LINHAS RELEVANTES:"
  ($interesting -join [Environment]::NewLine)
) -join [Environment]::NewLine
U8 $Contract ($contractText+[Environment]::NewLine)
L ("[PASS] contrato extraido="+$Contract)
L ("[INFO] fields descobertos="+(($keys | Sort-Object) -join ","))

L ""
L "===== 5/9 LOCALIZAR REFERENCIAS REAIS DE CREATE COMPRAS ====="
$refs=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $candidate "public") -Recurse -File -Filter "*.js" | ForEach-Object {
  $f=$_.FullName
  $fl=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f)
  for($j=0;$j -lt $fl.Count;$j++){
    if($fl[$j] -match '(?i)comprasService.*create|\.create\s*\(|createCompra|novaCompra|salvarCompra'){
      $rel=$f.Substring($candidate.Length).TrimStart('\')
      $refs.Add(("{0}:{1}: {2}" -f $rel,($j+1),$fl[$j].Trim()))
    }
  }
}
if($refs.Count -gt 0){
  Add-Content -LiteralPath $Contract -Value ("`r`nREFERENCIAS DE CREATE:`r`n"+($refs -join "`r`n")) -Encoding UTF8
  L ("[PASS] referencias create="+$refs.Count)
} else {
  L "[INFO] create e chamado indiretamente; contrato do service sera fonte canonica"
}

L ""
L "===== 6/9 VALIDAR TOOLKIT + PROVAS REUTILIZAVEIS ====="

$preflight=Join-Path $Toolkit "preflight.ps1"
Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runner) "crud-runner.ps1 ausente"
Need (Test-Path -LiteralPath $preflight) "preflight.ps1 ausente"
$cart=Join-Path $Profiles "cartoes.json"

L "`n===== 2/8 RECUPERAR CANDIDATO ====="
$m=[regex]::Match($wt,'(?m)^CANDIDATE=(.+)$')
if(-not $m.Success){
 $ctx=Join-Path $w15.FullName "P4_6_W15_MACRO_CONTEXT.txt"

 $m=[regex]::Match($ct,'(?m)^CANDIDATE=(.+)$')

foreach($f in $files){
 $txt=Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Raw
 foreach($mm in [regex]::Matches($txt,'(?s)\{[^{}]{0,2500}(?:fornecedorId|insumoId|formaPagamento|qtdEmbalagens|precoUnitario)[^{}]{0,2500}\}')){
   $o=$mm.Value
   if($o-match '(?:data|fornecedorId|itens|valor|subtotal|quantidade)'){
     $rel=$f.FullName.Substring($candidate.Length).TrimStart('\')
     $ev.Add("FILE="+$rel+"`r`n"+$o+"`r`n---")
     $objects.Add($o)
   }
 }
}
Need ($objects.Count-gt 0) "nenhum objeto real de Compra localizado"
Save $Evidence (($ev -join "`r`n")+"`r`n")
L ("[PASS] objetos candidatos="+$objects.Count)

 [void]$required.Add($mm.Groups[1].Value)
}
foreach($k in @("data","fornecedorId","itens","formaPagamento","valorTotal")){
 if($st-match ('(?i)\b'+[regex]::Escape($k)+'\b')){[void]$required.Add($k)}
}
L ("[INFO] campos contratuais="+(($required|Sort-Object)-join ","))

$payloadObj=[ordered]@{
 _meta=[ordered]@{
   entity="compras"; purpose="staging-e2e"; source="real-service-and-real-call-sites"
   resolveBeforeE2E=@("fornecedorId","insumoId","lancamentoFinanceiroId")
 }
 data=(Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd")
 fornecedorId="__P4_E2E_FORNECEDOR__"
 insumoId="__P4_E2E_INSUMO__"
 itens=@([ordered]@{
   insumoId="__P4_E2E_INSUMO__"; quantidade=1; qtdEmbalagens=1
   precoUnitario=1.00; precoEmbalagem=1.00; subtotal=1.00
 })
 formaPagamento="pix"
 descontoValor=0
 subtotal=1.00
 valorUnitario=1.00
 valorTotal=1.00
 quantidade=1
 qtdEmbalagens=1
 precoUnitario=1.00
 precoEmbalagem=1.00
 custoUnitarioLiquido=1.00
 status="pendente"
 observacoes="P4.6 W15 E2E staging"
 lancamentoFinanceiroId=$null
}
$json=$payloadObj|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
Save $Payload ($json+"`r`n")
L ("[PASS] payload candidato="+$Payload)

L "`n===== 6/8 VALIDAR PAYLOAD CONTRA SINAIS DO CONTRATO ====="
